from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_stage_joint_trial as trial
from tools import test_qsa_prefill_stage_joint as joint_tests


class BenchmarkOnlyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def options(self, directory, skip):
        argv = [
            "benchmark",
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "query-stage-joint",
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--compare-previous-tuning",
            "--previous-tuning",
            "combined",
            "--report-dir",
            str(directory),
        ]
        if skip:
            argv.append("--skip-accuracy")
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", argv), patch.object(
            bench, "parent", return_value=0
        ) as parent:
            self.assertEqual(bench.main(), 0)
            options, selected, _ = parent.call_args.args
        self.assertEqual(len(selected), 30)
        self.assertEqual(options.skip_accuracy, skip)
        return options

    def test_real_parent_skips_only_standalone_gate_and_preserves_default(self):
        for skip in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(skip=skip), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                directory = Path(folder)
                options = self.options(directory, skip)
                source = directory / "native-input.py"
                source.write_bytes(b"native")
                options.reference_file = str(source)
                case = bench.workloads.cases("scored-prefill")[0]
                phases = []

                def child(command, **kw):
                    if "--preflight" in command:
                        phases.append("preflight")
                        bench.support.write_json(
                            directory / "preflight.json",
                            dict(status="passed", runtime={}),
                        )
                    else:
                        phases.append("worker")
                        self.assertIn("--worker", command)
                        bench.support.write_json(
                            directory / (case["name"] + ".json"),
                            dict(status="passed", case=case, stages={}, runtime={}),
                        )
                    self.assertNotIn("--skip-accuracy", command)  # Parent-only flag.
                    return types.SimpleNamespace(returncode=0)

                def accuracy(options, directory, summary, *args):
                    phases.append("pytest")
                    summary["accuracy"] = dict(status="passed")

                # Parent work is real;only GPU/subprocess IO and table formatting
                # are mocked. Default and skipped paths both reach preflight/workers.
                with patch.dict(
                    os.environ,
                    {
                        "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "GPU-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
                    },
                ), patch.object(bench, "configure_environment"), patch.object(
                    bench.support, "gpu_guard_module"
                ), patch.object(
                    bench, "idle_gate", return_value=True
                ) as idle, patch.object(
                    bench, "runtime_identity", return_value="fixed"
                ), patch.object(
                    bench, "run_accuracy_gate", side_effect=accuracy
                ) as gate, patch.object(
                    bench.subprocess, "run", side_effect=child
                ), patch.object(
                    bench.support, "command", return_value={}
                ), patch.object(
                    bench.ab, "REFERENCE_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(b"native").hexdigest()
                ), patch.object(
                    bench, "write_table"
                ), contextlib.redirect_stdout(
                    io.StringIO()
                ):
                    self.assertEqual(bench.parent(options, [case], directory), 0)
                self.assertEqual(
                    phases,
                    (
                        ["preflight", "worker"]
                        if skip
                        else ["preflight", "pytest", "worker"]
                    ),
                )
                self.assertEqual(gate.call_count, 0 if skip else 1)
                self.assertEqual(idle.call_count, 2)
                summary = json.loads((directory / "stage-summary.json").read_text())
                self.assertEqual(summary["manifest"]["options"]["skip_accuracy"], skip)
                self.assertEqual(summary["status"], "passed")
                if skip:
                    self.assertEqual(
                        summary["accuracy"]["status"], "skipped_by_request"
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(summary["accuracy"]["counts"], {})
                    self.assertFalse(summary["accuracy"]["full_suite_validated"])
                    self.assertEqual(
                        json.loads((directory / "accuracy-skipped.json").read_text()),
                        summary["accuracy"],
                    )
                    self.assertFalse((directory / "accuracy-full.json").exists())

    def test_skip_never_turns_missing_accuracy_into_acceptance(self):
        summary = joint_tests.StageJointTests().summary()
        self.assertTrue(trial.acceptance(summary)["measurement_valid"])
        summary["manifest"]["options"]["skip_accuracy"] = True
        summary["accuracy"] = dict(status="skipped_by_request", counts={})
        result = trial.acceptance(summary)
        self.assertFalse(result["measurement_valid"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["target_met"])
        self.assertFalse(result["formal_production_acceptance"])

    def test_skip_parser_scope_and_worker_numeric_guards_remain(self):
        for args in (
            ["--skip-accuracy"],
            ["--compiler", "flagtree", "--skip-accuracy", "--worker", "x"],
        ):
            with patch.object(
                sys, "argv", ["benchmark", *args]
            ), contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
                with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as error:
                    bench.main()
                self.assertEqual(error.exception.code, 2)
        tree = ast.parse(Path(bench.__file__).read_text())
        worker = next(
            n
            for n in tree.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "worker"
        )
        self.assertNotIn("skip_accuracy", ast.unparse(worker))
        self.assertIn("guarded_telemetry", ast.unparse(worker))
        self.assertIn("validate_pipeline", ast.unparse(worker))
        self.assertIn("validate_topk", ast.unparse(worker))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Selective routing and exact original-binary fallback contracts."""

import copy
import types
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import qsa_prefill_bf16_query_policy as policy
from tools import qsa_prefill_query_split_matched as fixed


class PolicyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def config(self, rows, tiles, parts=1):
        return dict(
            TILE_R=rows,
            BLOCK_N=64,
            K_TILES=tiles,
            num_warps=4,
            num_stages=1,
            num_ctas=1,
            QUERY_PARTS=parts,
        )

    def test_parameter_gate_is_joint_and_legacy_behavior_is_retained(self):
        for rows, tiles, expected in (
            (64, 16, 2),
            (32, 4, 1),
            (64, 4, 1),
            (32, 16, 1),
            (16, 16, 1),
        ):
            config = self.config(rows, tiles)
            self.assertEqual(policy.parts(config, "large-tile"), expected)
            self.assertEqual(policy.parts(config, "large-tile", "baseline"), 1)
            self.assertEqual(policy.parts(config, "all"), 2 if rows >= 32 else 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            policy.parts(self.config(64, 16), "unknown")

    def test_proxy_uses_the_exact_original_jit_and_preserves_arguments(self):
        calls = []

        class JIT:
            def __init__(self, name):
                self.name = name

            def __getitem__(self, grid):
                def run(*args, **kwargs):
                    calls.append((self.name, grid, args, kwargs))
                    return self.name

                return run

        baseline, split = JIT("original"), JIT("split")
        proxy = policy.RoutedJIT(baseline, split)
        self.assertIs(proxy.baseline, baseline)
        token = object()
        self.assertEqual(proxy[(2, 3)](token, QUERY_PARTS=1, TILE_R=32), "original")
        self.assertEqual(proxy[(2, 3)](token, QUERY_PARTS=2, TILE_R=64), "split")
        self.assertIs(calls[0][2][0], token)
        self.assertEqual(calls[0][1], (2, 3))
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            proxy[(1,)](QUERY_PARTS=3)

    def pair(self):
        entries = []
        for side in range(2):
            configs = {
                (10, 0, 128): self.config(64, 16, 1 if side == 0 else 2),
                (5, 10, 128): self.config(32, 4, 1 if side == 0 else 2),
            }
            entries.append(
                types.SimpleNamespace(
                    _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=types.SimpleNamespace(
                        configs=configs, jit=object()
                    )
                )
            )
        return tuple(entries)

    def test_apply_changes_only_candidate_mode_and_preserves_original_entry(self):
        pair = self.pair()
        original = copy.deepcopy(pair[0]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.configs)
        jit = pair[0]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.jit
        policy.apply(pair, "large-tile")
        self.assertEqual(pair[0]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.configs, original)
        self.assertIs(pair[1]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.jit.baseline, jit)
        self.assertEqual(
            pair[1]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.configs[(5, 10, 128)]["QUERY_PARTS"], 1
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            pair[1]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.configs[(10, 0, 128)]["QUERY_PARTS"], 2
        )
        bad = self.pair()
        bad[1]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.configs[(5, 10, 128)]["num_stages"] = 2
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            policy.apply(bad, "large-tile")

    def records(self):
        left = [
            dict(
                chunk=[10, 0, 128],
                constants=self.config(64, 16),
                cubin_sha256="a",
                ptx_sha256="b",
            ),
            dict(
                chunk=[5, 10, 128],
                constants=self.config(32, 4),
                cubin_sha256="c",
                ptx_sha256="d",
            ),
        ]
        right = copy.deepcopy(left)
        right[0]["constants"]["QUERY_PARTS"] = 2
        right[0]["cubin_sha256"] = "new"
        right[0]["ptx_sha256"] = "new"
        return left, right

    def test_freeze_accepts_mixed_modes_but_rejects_changed_fallback_binary(self):
        left, right = self.records()

        def run(bad=False):
            pair = self.pair()
            values = [left, copy.deepcopy(right)]
            if bad:
                values[1][1]["cubin_sha256"] = "wrong-original"

            def record(modules):
                i = 0 if modules[0] is pair[0] else 1
                return dict(baseline=values[i])

            with patch.object(fixed, "freeze_and_records", side_effect=record):
                return policy.freeze(pair, "large-tile")

        result = run()
        self.assertTrue(result["configs_match"])
        self.assertEqual(result["query_parts_pair"], [1, "gated"])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "original P1 binary"):
            run(True)
        right[1]["cubin_sha256"] = ""
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            policy.verify_fallback(left, right, "large-tile")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import contextlib
import copy
import io
import json
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import qsa_prefill_bf16_query_probe as probe
from tools import qsa_prefill_query_split_matched as fixed
from tools import qsa_prefill_stage_joint_trial as joint


class ProbeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def record(self):
        traces = [
            dict(
                offset=o,
                rows=n,
                width=29696,
                route="rectangular",
                constants=dict(probe.CONFIG),
            )
            for o, n in ((0, 4519), (4519, 4519), (9038, 4519), (13557, 2827))
        ]
        return dict(
            status="passed",
            candidate_kind="query-stage-joint",
            cache_granularity=dict(production=traces),
            runtime=dict(operator_binding=dict(candidate_sha256=probe.OLD_KERNEL_SHA)),
        )

    def test_actual_private_source_changes_only_split_gate(self):
        facts = probe.verify_source()
        self.assertEqual(facts["baseline_sha256"], probe.OLD_KERNEL_SHA)
        self.assertNotEqual(facts["baseline_sha256"], facts["candidate_sha256"])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            (root / "tools").mkdir()
            old = probe.ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py"
            (root / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py").write_bytes(
                old.read_bytes()
            )
            candidate = root / "tools/qsa_prefill_bf16_query_probe_kernel.py"
            candidate.write_text(
                (probe.ROOT / candidate.relative_to(root))
                .read_text()
                .replace("out_dtype=tl.float32", "out_dtype=tl.float16", 1)
            )
            with patch.object(probe, "ROOT", root), self.assertRaisesRegex(
                RuntimeError, "beyond"
            ):
                probe.verify_source()

    def test_rejects_relabelled_or_reconfigured_saved_baselines(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            path = Path(folder) / (probe.CASE + ".json")
            value = self.record()
            path.write_text(json.dumps(value))
            self.assertEqual(probe.baseline_record(folder)[0], value)
            variants = []
            for key, change in (("num_stages", 2), ("TILE_R", 32), ("QUERY_PARTS", 2)):
                bad = copy.deepcopy(value)
                bad["cache_granularity"]["production"][0]["constants"][key] = change
                variants.append(bad)
            bad = copy.deepcopy(value)
            bad["cache_granularity"]["production"][3]["offset"] += 1
            variants.append(bad)
            bad = copy.deepcopy(value)
            bad["runtime"]["operator_binding"]["candidate_sha256"] = "changed"
            variants.append(bad)
            bad = copy.deepcopy(value)
            bad["status"] = "failed"
            variants.append(bad)
            for bad in variants:
                path.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                    probe.baseline_record(folder)

    def test_only_candidate_jit_changes_without_touching_shared_source(self):
        original, replacement = object(), object()
        topk = object()
        pair = tuple(
            types.SimpleNamespace(
                _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=types.SimpleNamespace(jit=original),
                persistent_topk=topk,
            )
            for _ in range(2)
        )
        kernel = types.ModuleType("tools.qsa_prefill_bf16_query_probe_kernel")
        kernel._qsa_prefill_score_kernel = types.SimpleNamespace(
            fn=types.SimpleNamespace(fn=replacement)
        )
        source, production, traces = (
            object(),
            object(),
            self.record()["cache_granularity"]["production"],
        )
        with patch.dict("sys.modules", {kernel.__name__: kernel}), patch.object(
            joint, "candidate_module", return_value=source
        ), patch.object(fixed, "modules", return_value=pair) as build:
            actual = probe.make_pair(production, traces)
        build.assert_called_once_with(source, source, traces, query_parts=(1, 2))
        self.assertIs(actual[0]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.jit, original)
        self.assertIs(actual[1]._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.jit, replacement)
        self.assertIs(actual[0].persistent_topk, actual[1].persistent_topk)

    def test_pipeline_stores_feed_same_chunk_topk_and_frozen_scores_are_separate(self):
        calls = []
        score_outputs = [object(), object()]
        chunks = [
            dict(
                score_args=(i,),
                score_kwargs={},
                topk_args=(None, object(), object(), object()),
                topk_kwargs=dict(k=512),
            )
            for i in range(2)
        ]
        common = [object(), object()]

        def score(index):
            calls.append(("score", index))
            return score_outputs[index]

        def topk(*args, **kwargs):
            calls.append(("topk", args, kwargs))

        module = types.SimpleNamespace(_prefill_logits=score, persistent_topk=topk)
        bundle = probe.bind(module, chunks, common)
        bundle["pipeline"]()
        self.assertEqual([x[0] for x in calls], ["score", "topk", "score", "topk"])
        for call, scores, chunk in zip(calls[1::2], score_outputs, chunks):
            self.assertIs(call[1][0], scores)
            for a, b in zip(call[1][1:], chunk["topk_args"][1:]):
                self.assertIs(a, b)
        calls.clear()
        bundle["topk"]()
        for call, scores in zip(calls, common):
            self.assertIs(call[1][0], scores)
        self.assertNotEqual(common, score_outputs)

    def test_formatter_keeps_topk_and_does_not_mask_partial_failure(self):
        samples = dict(median=10)
        row = dict(
            baseline_us=samples,
            candidate_us=samples,
            speedup=1,
            paired_ratios=dict(min=0.99, max=1.01),
            measurement_validated=True,
        )
        result = dict(
            stages=dict(topk=row),
            self_controls={"P1:score": dict(status="validating")},
            error="original validation failure",
        )
        stream = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stream):
            probe.print_results(result)
        for word in ("topk", "1.0000", "original validation failure", "全30组"):
            self.assertIn(word, stream.getvalue())

    def run_worker(
        self,
        root,
        *,
        fail_pipeline=False,
        case_name=None,
        skip_boundaries=False,
        query_policy="all",
    ):
        from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench

        class View:
            def __getitem__(self, key):
                return self

        tensor = View()
        args = (tensor,) * 10
        topk = lambda *a, **kw: None
        pair = tuple(
            types.SimpleNamespace(
                _prefill_logits=lambda *a, **kw: tensor, persistent_topk=topk
            )
            for _ in range(2)
        )
        chunk = dict(
            offset=0,
            rows=3,
            width=8,
            score_args=(tensor,),
            score_kwargs={},
            topk_args=(tensor, tensor, tensor, tensor),
            topk_kwargs={},
            common_logits=tensor,
        )
        options = types.SimpleNamespace(
            report_dir=str(root),
            baseline_report="saved",
            rounds=2,
            kernel_warmup_ms=200,
            kernel_rep_ms=100,
        )

        from tools import qsa_prefill_bf16_query_policy as policy
        from tools import qsa_prefill_bf16_query_upstream as suite

        options.query_policy = query_policy

        if case_name:
            options.suite = "upstream-prefill"
            options.worker_case = case_name
            options.cases = (
                [bench.workloads.cases()[0]["name"], case_name]
                if skip_boundaries
                else [case_name]
            )

        def timer(fn):
            fn()
            return 10.0

        def pipeline(*a, **kw):
            if fail_pipeline:
                raise AssertionError("injected pipeline numerical failure")
            return 3

        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            patches = (
                patch.object(
                    suite,
                    "saved_record",
                    return_value=(dict(inputs=["stable"], compiler_identity={}), []),
                ),
                patch.object(
                    probe,
                    "baseline_record",
                    return_value=(dict(inputs=["stable"], runtime={}), []),
                ),
                patch.object(probe, "compiler_identity", return_value={}),
                patch.object(
                    probe, "boundary_checks", return_value=[dict(status="passed")]
                ),
                patch.object(probe, "make_pair", return_value=pair),
                patch.object(
                    bench,
                    "runtime",
                    return_value=(
                        object(),
                        object(),
                        object(),
                        None,
                        object(),
                        types.SimpleNamespace(synchronize=lambda: None),
                        dict(uuid="GPU-test"),
                    ),
                ),
                patch.object(bench.workloads, "make_inputs", return_value=args),
                patch.object(bench.support, "fingerprint", return_value=["stable"]),
                patch.object(bench.ab, "observe", return_value=[chunk]),
                patch.object(bench, "verify_geometry"),
                patch.object(bench.support, "sample_rows", return_value=[0]),
                patch.object(bench.scoring, "validate_scores", return_value=3),
                patch.object(bench, "validate_reference_selection"),
                patch.object(bench, "validate_pipeline", side_effect=pipeline),
                patch.object(
                    fixed,
                    "freeze_and_records",
                    return_value=dict(baseline=[], candidate=[], configs_match=True),
                ),
                patch.object(
                    bench.scoring,
                    "make_timer",
                    return_value=(timer, dict(mode="kernel")),
                ),
                patch.object(bench.support, "gpu_guard_module", return_value=object()),
                patch.object(
                    bench.support,
                    "guarded_telemetry",
                    return_value=dict(status="passed"),
                ),
                contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()),
            )
            if query_policy != "all":
                stack.enter_context(
                    patch.object(
                        policy,
                        "freeze",
                        return_value=dict(
                            baseline=[], candidate=[], configs_match=True
                        ),
                    )
                )
            for item in patches:
                stack.enter_context(item)
            code = probe.worker(options)
        return code, json.loads(
            (root / ((case_name + ".json") if case_name else "probe.json")).read_text()
        )

    def test_worker_records_all_stages_and_four_controls_with_original_timer(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            code, result = self.run_worker(Path(folder))
            self.assertEqual(code, 0, result.get("error"))
            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "passed")
            self.assertEqual(set(result["stages"]), {"score", "topk", "pipeline"})
            self.assertEqual(len(result["self_controls"]), 4)
            self.assertTrue(result["same_buffers"] and result["same_topk"])
            self.assertFalse(result["acceptance_eligible"])
            self.assertEqual(result["kernels_before"], result["kernels_after"])
            for value in result["stages"].values():
                self.assertTrue(value["measurement_validated"])
                self.assertEqual(
                    value["measurement_order"],
                    [["baseline", "candidate"], ["candidate", "baseline"]],
                )
            self.assertTrue((Path(folder) / "probe-timings.tsv").is_file())

    def test_selective_worker_marks_gated_policy_without_relabeling_as_all_p2(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            code, result = self.run_worker(Path(folder), query_policy="large-tile")
            self.assertEqual(code, 0, result.get("error"))
            self.assertEqual(result["query_policy"], "large-tile")
            self.assertEqual(result["query_parts_pair"], [1, "gated"])

    def test_failed_validation_stops_probe_and_preserves_error(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            code, result = self.run_worker(Path(folder), fail_pipeline=True)
            self.assertEqual(code, 1)
            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "failed")
            self.assertIn("injected pipeline numerical failure", result["error"])
            self.assertFalse(
                result["stages"]["pipeline"].get("measurement_validated", False)
            )
            self.assertEqual(result["self_controls"], {})
            self.assertFalse((Path(folder) / "probe-timings.tsv").exists())

    def test_compiler_identity_ignores_paths_but_rejects_binary_change(self):
        info = dict(
            torch_version="2.10",
            triton_version="3.6",
            versions=dict(vllm="0.31"),
            compiler_files=dict(c=dict(path="old", sha256="compiler")),
            flagtree_runtime=dict(
                files=dict(t=dict(path="old", sha256="triton")),
                ptxas=dict(path="old", sha256="assembler"),
                cuda=dict(libcuda="old", libcuda_sha256="driver"),
            ),
        )
        other = copy.deepcopy(info)
        other["flagtree_runtime"]["cuda"]["libcuda"] = "new-extracted-path"
        self.assertEqual(probe.compiler_identity(info), probe.compiler_identity(other))
        other["flagtree_runtime"]["files"]["t"]["sha256"] = "different"
        self.assertNotEqual(
            probe.compiler_identity(info), probe.compiler_identity(other)
        )

    unittest.main()

        from tools import qsa_prefill_profiling as profiling

            report_dir=str(root),

        with patch.object(probe, "prepare_environment"), patch.object(

            bench, "idle_gate", return_value=True
        ), contextlib.redirect_stdout(
            io.StringIO()
        ):

    def test_suite_worker_uses_requested_case_and_checks_boundaries_once(self):
        from tools.test_qsa_prefill_bf16_query_probe import ProbeTests

        for skip in (False, True):
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                name = upstream.cases()[2]["name"]
                code, record = ProbeTests().run_worker(
                    Path(folder), case_name=name, skip_boundaries=skip
                )
                self.assertEqual(code, 0, record.get("error"))
                self.assertEqual(record["case"]["name"], name)
                self.assertIsNone(record["fixed_config"])
                self.assertEqual(
                    record["boundary_checks"][0]["status"],
                    "covered_by_first_case" if skip else "passed",
                )
                self.assertTrue((Path(folder) / (name + ".tsv")).is_file())

    def test_full_suite_is_complete_only_with_all_twelve_validated_records(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            code, summary, calls = self.coordinate(root, full=True)
            self.assertEqual(code, 0, summary.get("error"))
            self.assertEqual(len(calls), 12)
            self.assertTrue(summary["full_upstream12_complete"])
            self.assertFalse(summary["acceptance_eligible"])
            self.assertEqual(summary["aggregate"]["pipeline"]["count"], 12)
            self.assertEqual(
                len((root / "upstream-probe-timings.tsv").read_text().splitlines()), 37
            )

    def test_selective_suite_keeps_mixed_modes_and_rejects_wrong_worker_policy(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            code, summary, calls = self.coordinate(
                Path(folder), full=True, query_policy="large-tile"
            )
            self.assertEqual(code, 0, summary.get("error"))
            self.assertEqual(summary["query_policy"], "large-tile")
            self.assertTrue(summary["full_upstream12_complete"])
            self.assertTrue(
                any(
                    {
                        k["constants"]["QUERY_PARTS"]
                        for k in r["kernels_before"]["candidate"]
                    }
                    == {1, 2}
                    for r in summary["cases"]
                )
            )
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            code, summary, calls = self.coordinate(
                Path(folder), query_policy="large-tile", wrong_policy=True
            )
            self.assertEqual(code, 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
            self.assertIn("Worker query policy differs", summary["error"])

    def test_failure_stops_later_workers_and_retains_partial_data(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            code, summary, calls = self.coordinate(root, fail_second=True)
            self.assertEqual(code, 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)
            self.assertEqual(summary["status"], "failed")
            self.assertEqual(len(summary["cases"]), 1)
            self.assertFalse(summary["full_upstream12_complete"])
            self.assertEqual(summary["worker_exit_codes"][calls[-1]], 124)
            self.assertIn("exit=124", summary["error"])
            self.assertEqual(
                len((root / "upstream-probe-timings.tsv").read_text().splitlines()), 4
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Copyright 2026 FlagOS Contributors
"""Execute the real cache-key/run methods with a CPU-only fake device runtime."""

import ast
import contextlib
import hashlib
import inspect
import types
import unittest
from collections import OrderedDict
from itertools import starmap
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import qsa_prefill_cache_granularity as trial
from tools import qsa_prefill_triton_ab as ab

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRODUCTION = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py"
LIBENTRY = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/utils/libentry.py"


class Tensor:
    def __init__(self, dtype):
        self.dtype = dtype

    def data_ptr(self):
        return 4096


def cache_runtime():
    """Extract actual methods, preserving their control flow and parameter lists."""
    production = ast.parse(PRODUCTION.read_text())
    library = ast.parse(LIBENTRY.read_text())
    score = next(
        n
        for n in production.body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"
    )
    local = next(n for n in production.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef))
    entry = next(
        n for n in library.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "LibEntry"
    )
    tuner = next(
        n for n in library.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "LibTuner"
    )
    methods = [
        n
        for n in entry.body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in ("key", "run")
    ]
    get_key = next(
        n for n in tuner.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "get_key"
    )
    signature_function = ast.FunctionDef(
        name="signature_function", args=score.args, body=[ast.Pass()], decorator_list=[]
    )
    base = ast.ClassDef(
        name="LibEntry", bases=[], keywords=[], body=methods, decorator_list=[]
    )
    tree = ast.Module(body=[base, local, signature_function], type_ignores=[])
    env = dict(
        OrderedDict=OrderedDict,
        inspect=inspect,
        runtime=types.SimpleNamespace(
            device=types.SimpleNamespace(vendor_name="nvidia")
        ),
        torch_device_fn=types.SimpleNamespace(current_device=lambda: 0),
        major_version=3,
        minor_version=6,
        tl=types.SimpleNamespace(constexpr=object()),
        starmap=starmap,
    )
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(tree), str(PRODUCTION), "exec"), env)
    exec(
        compile(
            ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[get_key], type_ignores=[])),
            str(LIBENTRY),
            "exec",
        ),
        env,
    )
    signature = inspect.signature(env["signature_function"])
    dns = {"num_rows", "query_offset", "max_query_len"}
    params = [
        types.SimpleNamespace(
            num=i,
            name=p.name,
            is_constexpr=p.annotation is env["tl"].constexpr,
            do_not_specialize=p.name in dns,
            default=p.default,
        )
        for i, p in enumerate(signature.parameters.values())
    ]
    keys = ast.literal_eval(
        next(
            k.value
            for d in score.decorator_list
            if isinstance(d, ast.Call)
            and isinstance(d.func, ast.Name)
            and d.func.id == "libtuner"
            for k in d.keywords
            if k.arg == "key"
        )
    )

    class JIT:
        pass

    class Kernel:
        def __init__(self, tile):
            self.tile, self.launches = tile, []

        def __getitem__(self, grid):
            return lambda *args: self.launches.append((grid, args))

    class Tuner:
        get_key = env["get_key"]

        def __init__(self):
            self.fn = JIT()
            self.fn.params = params
            self.keys, self.strategy, self.calls = keys, None, []

        def run(self, *args, **kwargs):
            named = dict(zip(signature.parameters, args), **kwargs)
            self.calls.append(self.get_key(named))
            tile = 32 if named["num_rows"] >= 64 else 4
            self.best_config = types.SimpleNamespace(
                num_warps=8,
                num_stages=2,
                num_ctas=1,
                pre_hook=None,
                kwargs=dict(TILE_R=tile, BLOCK_N=64, K_TILES=4),
            )
            kernel = Kernel(tile)
            kernel[named["grid"](self.best_config.kwargs)](*args)
            return kernel

    env["triton"] = types.SimpleNamespace(
        runtime=types.SimpleNamespace(
            JITFunction=JIT,
            Autotuner=Tuner,
            Heuristics=type("Heuristics", (), {}),
        )
    )

    def make(local=True):
        cls = env["_QSAScoreEntry" if local else "LibEntry"]
        result = cls()
        result.fn = Tuner()
        result.arg_names = list(signature.parameters)
        result.divisibility, result.kernel_cache = 16, ({},)
        result._has_flagtune_tuner = False
        result.lock, result.signature = contextlib.nullcontext(), signature
        result.jit_function = result.fn.fn
        result.specialize_indices = [
            p.num for p in params if not p.is_constexpr and not p.do_not_specialize
        ]
        result.do_not_specialize_indices = [
            p.num for p in params if p.do_not_specialize
        ]
        return result

    def launch(entry, rows=64, offset=0, dtype="bfloat16", maximum=81):
        values = {p.name: 1 for p in params if not p.is_constexpr}
        for name in list(values)[:6]:
            values[name] = Tensor(dtype if name in ("q_ptr", "cache_ptr") else "int32")
        values.update(
            num_rows=rows, query_offset=offset, max_query_len=maximum, logits_width=1088
        )
        return entry.run(
            *values.values(),
            PAGE_SIZE=16,
            NUM_HEADS=4,
            HEAD_DIM=128,
            IS_FP8=dtype != "bfloat16",
            grid=lambda meta: (1, (rows + meta["TILE_R"] - 1) // meta["TILE_R"], 1),
        )

    return make, launch


class CacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_source_normalization_recovers_exact_previous_ten(self):
        source = PRODUCTION.read_text()
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(), ab.INTEGRATED_PRODUCTION_SHA256
        )
        restored = trial.round1_source(source)
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(restored.encode()).hexdigest(), trial.ROUND1_SOURCE_SHA256
        )
        self.assertEqual(trial.round1_source(restored), restored)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "outside the operator-local"):
            trial.round1_source(source + "# unexpected body edit\n")

    def test_real_run_separates_tail_and_reuses_repeated_rows(self):
        make, launch = cache_runtime()
        for local, expected_calls in ((False, 1), (True, 2)):
            entry = make(local)
            first = launch(entry)
            second = launch(entry, rows=17, offset=64)
            repeat = launch(entry, offset=128)
            self.assertEqual(len(entry.fn.calls), expected_calls)
            self.assertEqual(len(entry.kernel_cache[0]), expected_calls)
            self.assertIs(first[0], repeat[0])
            self.assertEqual(first[1]["TILE_R"], 32)
            self.assertEqual(second[1]["TILE_R"], 4 if local else 32)
            if local:
                self.assertIsNot(first[0], second[0])
            else:
                self.assertIs(first[0], second[0])

    def test_existing_tuner_key_and_dtype_order_are_preserved(self):
        make, launch = cache_runtime()
        entry = make()
        launch(entry)
        key = next(iter(entry.kernel_cache[0]))
        self.assertEqual(key[-1], entry.fn.calls[-1])
        self.assertEqual(
            key[-1][-6:], ("bfloat16", "bfloat16", "int32", "int32", "int32", "int32")
        )
        entry.fn.strategy = [lambda value: value for _ in entry.fn.keys]
        launch(entry, rows=17, offset=64)
        self.assertEqual(list(entry.kernel_cache[0])[-1][-1], entry.fn.calls[-1])
        launch(entry, maximum=97)
        launch(entry, dtype="float8_e4m3fn")
        self.assertEqual(len(entry.fn.calls), 4)

    def test_baseline_identity_and_selector_are_explicit(self):
        for kind, count in (("eight", "eight"), ("round1", "ten")):
            identity = trial.previous_identity(kind)
            self.assertIn(count, identity["baseline_kind"])
            production = object()
            with patch(
                "tools.qsa_prefill_tuning_round1.previous_module",
                return_value=production,
            ) as factory:
                self.assertIs(trial.previous_module(production, kind), production)
            self.assertEqual(
                factory.call_args.kwargs["rectangular_group"], identity["config_group"]
            )
        for function, args in (
            (trial.previous_identity, ("unknown",)),
            (trial.previous_module, (None, "unknown")),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                function(*args)

    def test_observation_records_actual_configs_without_extra_launches(self):
        from tools import qsa_prefill_kernel_resources as resources

        class Entry:
            arg_names = ("num_rows", "query_offset", "logits_width")

            def __init__(self):
                self.calls = 0
                self.kernel_cache = ({},)
                self.fn = types.SimpleNamespace(
                    get_key=lambda values: (values["num_rows"],)
                )

            def __getitem__(self, grid):
                def invoke(*values, **kwargs):
                    self.calls += 1
                    self.kernel_cache[0][values[0]] = object()
                    return object(), dict(TILE_R=values[0])

                return invoke

        rectangular, compact = Entry(), Entry()
        module = types.SimpleNamespace(
            _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=rectangular,
            _qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel=compact,
        )

        def observe(module, topk, args):
            self.assertEqual(topk, "persistent_topk")
            chunks = []
            for offset, rows in ((0, 64), (64, 17)):
                module._qsa_prefill_score_kernel[(1,)](rows, offset, 1088)
                chunks.append(dict(offset=offset, rows=rows, width=1088))
            return chunks

        with patch.object(ab, "observe", observe), patch.object(
            resources, "compiled_record", return_value={"registers": 32}
        ):
            chunks, traces = trial.observe(module, ())
        self.assertEqual(rectangular.calls, 2)
        self.assertEqual(compact.calls, 0)
        self.assertEqual([t["constants"]["TILE_R"] for t in traces], [64, 17])
        self.assertEqual([t["entry_count"] for t in traces], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(
            ab.signatures(chunks),
            [(t["offset"], t["rows"], t["width"]) for t in traces],
        )
        self.assertIs(module._qsa_prefill_score_kernel, rectangular)
        self.assertIs(module._qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel, compact)

        def mismatched(module, topk, args):
            observe(module, topk, args)
            return []

        with patch.object(ab, "observe", mismatched), patch.object(
            resources, "compiled_record", return_value={}
        ):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "chunk geometry"):
                trial.observe(module, ())
        self.assertIs(module._qsa_prefill_score_kernel, rectangular)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Exact-callable self controls, source pins, output owners and original AB/BA timing."""

import collections
import contextlib
import csv
import io
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_combined_controls as controls
from tools import qsa_prefill_query_controls as common
from tools import qsa_prefill_query_split_matched as matched

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class CombinedControlTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def modules():
        topk = object()
        production = types.SimpleNamespace(
            name="production",
            persistent_topk=topk,
            __file__=str(ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py"),
        )
        candidate = types.SimpleNamespace(
            name="combined",
            persistent_topk=topk,
            production_baseline=production,
            __file__=str(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py"),
        )
        return production, candidate

    def test_schedule_has_every_comparison_stage_condition_and_balanced_positions(self):
        jobs = controls.schedule(4)
        self.assertEqual(len(jobs), 144)
        counts = collections.Counter(
            (j["comparison"], j["stage"], j["condition"]) for j in jobs
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(counts), 36)
        self.assertEqual(set(counts.values()), {4})
        for comparison in controls.COMPARISONS:
            positions = collections.Counter(
                i % 3 for i, j in enumerate(jobs) if j["comparison"] == comparison
            )
            self.assertEqual(positions, {0: 16, 1: 16, 2: 16})
        for condition in common.CONDITIONS:
            positions = []
            for cycle in range(1, 5):
                row = [j for j in jobs if j["cycle"] == cycle]
                positions.append(
                    next(i for i, j in enumerate(row) if j["condition"] == condition)
                    // 9
                )
            self.assertEqual(sorted(positions), [0, 1, 2, 3])
        for bad in (-1, 0, 1, 2, 5):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                controls.schedule(bad)

    def test_binding_checks_use_frozen_sources_and_exact_baseline_topk(self):
        p, c = self.modules()
        result = dict(case=dict(name=controls.CASE), candidate_kind="query-joint-page")
        self.assertEqual(
            controls.verify_bindings(result, p, c)["combined"]["sha256"],
            controls.COMBINED_SHA256,
        )
        c.production_baseline = object()
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):

    def harness(self, *, bad_shared=False, changed_resources=False):
        production, candidate = self.modules()
        writes = []
        validations = []
        timed = []

        class Tensor:
            shape = (4, 8)

            def __init__(self, pointer):
                self.pointer = pointer

            def stride(self):
                return (8, 1)

            def data_ptr(self):
                return self.pointer

        def chunks(bank, pointer):
            return [
                dict(
                    bank=bank,
                    score_args=[None] * 5 + [Tensor(pointer)],
                    topk_args=[None, None, Tensor(pointer + 1), Tensor(pointer + 2)],
                )
            ]

        banks = dict(a=chunks("a", 10), b=chunks("b", 20))
        owners = dict(a=object(), b=object())

        def bind(native, module, native_chunks, captured):
            result = {}
            for stage in ("score", "topk", "pipeline"):

                def launch(stage=stage):
                    writes.append((module.name, captured[0]["bank"], stage))

                result[stage] = dict(candidate=launch)
            return result

        result = dict(
            case=dict(name=controls.CASE),
            candidate_kind="query-joint-page",
            cache_granularity=dict(
                production=[
                    dict(
                        rows=288,
                        offset=0,
                        width=1088,
                        route="rectangular",
                        constants={},
                    )
                ]
            ),
        )

        def validate(stage, fn, module, captured, args, context):
            fn()
            bank = captured[0]["bank"]
            self.assertIs(args, owners[bank])
            self.assertEqual(writes[-1], (module.name, bank, stage))
            validations.append(writes[-1])
            entry = result["combined_self_controls"]["measurements"][-1]
            if (
                bad_shared
                and entry["comparison"] == "production_self"
                and entry["same_callable"]
            ):
                self.assertEqual(entry["baseline_bank"], entry["candidate_bank"])
                raise AssertionError("invalid first shared owner")
            return 3

        def timer(fn):
            fn()
            timed.append(fn)
            # Deliberately abnormal self ratios must be retained,not clamped.
            return (1.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0)[(len(timed) - 1) % 4]

        api = types.SimpleNamespace(
            ab=types.SimpleNamespace(bind_stages=bind),
            scoring=types.SimpleNamespace(
                make_timer=lambda *a: (timer, dict(mode="kernel", includes_topk=False)),
                measure_scores=bench.scoring.measure_scores,
            ),
            support=bench.support,
        )
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            path = Path(folder) / "case.json"
            with patch.object(common, "assert_choice"), patch.object(
                matched, "modules", side_effect=lambda a, b, t: (a, b)
            ), patch.object(
                common,
                "freeze",
                side_effect=[
                    dict(same_tile=True),
                    dict(same_tile=not changed_resources),
                ],
            ), patch.object(
                controls, "validate_side", side_effect=validate
            ):

                def call():
                    controls.run(
                        types.SimpleNamespace(
                            combined_self_control_cycles=4,
                            rounds=2,
                            kernel_warmup_ms=200,
                            kernel_rep_ms=100,
                        ),
                        result,
                        path,
                        bench=api,
                        torch=None,
                        helpers=None,
                        device=types.SimpleNamespace(synchronize=lambda: None),
                        native=None,
                        candidate=candidate,
                        production=production,
                        native_chunks=[],
                        production_chunks=banks["a"],
                        candidate_chunks=banks["b"],
                        production_args=owners["a"],
                        args=owners["b"],
                        monitor=lambda label: dict(label=label),
                    )

                if bad_shared or changed_resources:
                    with self.assertRaises((AssertionError, RuntimeError)):
                        call()
                    self.assertNotEqual(
                        result["combined_self_controls"]["status"], "passed"
                    )
                    if bad_shared:
                        entry = result["combined_self_controls"]["measurements"][-1]
                        self.assertFalse(entry["measurement_validated"])
                        self.assertTrue(entry["same_callable"])
                        self.assertEqual(
                            validations[-1],
                            ("production", entry["baseline_bank"], entry["stage"]),
                        )
                    return
                call()
            d = result["combined_self_controls"]
            self.assertEqual(d["status"], "passed")
            self.assertFalse(d["formal_acceptance_eligible"])
            self.assertEqual(len(d["measurements"]), 144)
            self.assertEqual(len(validations), 576)
            self.assertEqual(len(timed), 576)
            exact = 0
            for i, e in enumerate(d["measurements"]):
                self.assertEqual(e["speedup"], 0.5)
                self.assertEqual(
                    e["measurement_order"],
                    [["baseline", "candidate"], ["candidate", "baseline"]],
                )
                self.assertEqual(
                    e["same_module"], e["comparison"] != "production_vs_combined"
                )
                self.assertEqual(
                    e["same_callable"],
                    e["same_module"] and e["baseline_bank"] == e["candidate_bank"],
                )
                self.assertEqual(timed[4 * i] is timed[4 * i + 1], e["same_callable"])
                self.assertIs(timed[4 * i], timed[4 * i + 3])
                self.assertIs(timed[4 * i + 1], timed[4 * i + 2])
                exact += e["same_callable"]
                self.assertTrue(e["measurement_validated"])
            self.assertEqual(exact, 48)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(path.read_text()), result)
            rows = list(
                csv.DictReader(
                    io.StringIO(path.with_suffix(".combined-controls.tsv").read_text()),
                    delimiter="\t",
                )
            )
            self.assertEqual(len(rows), 144)
            for row, e in zip(rows, d["measurements"]):
                self.assertEqual(row["comparison"], e["comparison"])
                self.assertEqual(float(row["speedup"]), 0.5)
                self.assertEqual(row["same_callable"], str(e["same_callable"]))

class CapturedCapacityBuilderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_real_builder_preserves_live_keys_and_allocates_captured_capacities(self):
        import numpy as np

        class Tensor(np.ndarray):
            def copy_(self, value):
                self[...] = value
                return self

            def long(self):
                return self.astype(np.int64).view(Tensor)

            def to(self, dtype):
                return self.astype(dtype).view(Tensor)

            def stride(self):
                return tuple(s // self.itemsize for s in self.strides)

        def tensor(value, dtype):
            return np.asarray(value, dtype=dtype).view(Tensor)

        torch = types.SimpleNamespace(
            float8_e4m3fn=np.uint8,
            zeros=lambda shape, dtype, device: np.zeros(shape, dtype=dtype).view(
                Tensor
            ),
            full=lambda shape, value, dtype, device: np.full(
                shape, value, dtype=dtype
            ).view(Tensor),
            randperm=lambda n, device: tensor(
                np.random.default_rng(13).permutation(n), np.int64
            ),
        )
        original = {}

        def base_inputs(queries, contexts, **kw):
            page, dim, heads = kw["page_size"], kw["head_dim"], kw["num_heads"]
            pages = [(c + page - 1) // page for c in contexts]
            cache = tensor(
                (np.arange(sum(pages) * page * dim) % 251).reshape(
                    sum(pages), page, 1, dim
                ),
                np.uint8,
            )
            table = tensor(np.full((len(queries), max(pages)), -1), np.int32)
            cursor = 0
            for r, count in enumerate(pages):
                table[r, :count] = np.arange(cursor, cursor + count)
                cursor += count
            starts = [0]
            for q in queries:
                starts.append(starts[-1] + q)
            original.update(
                cache=cache.copy(), table=table.copy(), visible=kw["visible"]
            )
            return (
                tensor(np.zeros((sum(queries), heads, dim)), np.uint8),
                cache,
                table,
                tensor(starts, np.int32),
                tensor(kw["visible"], np.int32),
                kw["k"] * kw["ratio"],
                kw["ratio"],
                max(queries),
                tensor(np.full((sum(queries), kw["k"]), -17), np.int32),
                max(contexts) * kw["ratio"],
            )

        # Run the actual shared remap/padding path at recorded capacities;uint8
        # stands for opaque FP8 bytes,not a substitute numerical score reference.
        for case in (fp8.cases()[0], fp8.cases()[5]):
            args = workloads.make_inputs(
                case,
                types.SimpleNamespace(make_inputs=base_inputs),
                torch,
                device="cpu",
            )
            info = workloads.geometry(case)
            for i, key in ((0, "q_shape"), (1, "cache_shape"), (2, "page_table_shape")):
                self.assertEqual(list(args[i].shape), info[key])
                self.assertEqual(
                    list(args[i].stride()), info["input_layout"][str(i)]["stride"]
                )
            self.assertEqual(args[3].tolist(), info["query_start_loc"])
            self.assertEqual(args[4].tolist(), original["visible"])
            self.assertEqual(args[9], case["batch_max_seq_len"])
            self.assertTrue(np.all(args[2][:, original["table"].shape[1] :] == -1))
            for request, row in enumerate(original["table"]):
                for column, old_id in enumerate(row):
                    if old_id >= 0:
                        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                            args[1][args[2][request, column]], original["cache"][old_id]
                        )
                    else:
                        self.assertEqual(args[2][request, column], -1)
            ids = set(args[2][args[2] >= 0].tolist())
            self.assertEqual(len(ids), info["active_physical_pages"])
            self.assertGreater(max(ids), info["active_physical_pages"] - 1)
            unused = next(i for i in range(2712) if i not in ids)
            self.assertTrue(np.all(args[1][unused] == 0))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""CPU gates for isolated pipeline-depth choices, source pins and report routing."""

import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import yaml

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_accuracy_profiles as profiles
from tools import qsa_prefill_cache_granularity as cache
from tools import qsa_prefill_loop_stage_trial as trial
from tools import test_qsa_prefill_query_page as combined_tests

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
YAML_PATH = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_nvidia/tune_configs.yaml"


class Config:
    def __init__(self, entry):
        self.values = dict(
            entry["META"],
            num_warps=entry["num_warps"],
            num_stages=entry["num_stages"],
            num_ctas=entry.get("num_ctas", 1),
        )

    def all_kwargs(self):
        return dict(self.values)


class Entry:
    def __init__(self, fn):
        self.fn = fn
        self.kernel_cache = [{}, {}]


class LoopStageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def configs(self):
        y = yaml.safe_load(YAML_PATH.read_text())
        return tuple(
            [Config(c) for c in y[key]]
            for key in (
                "qsa_select_paged_prefill_query_joint_score",
                trial.CONFIG_GROUP,
            )
        )

    def test_only_new_yaml_group_changes_and_all_choices_are_exact_stage1(self):
        current = yaml.safe_load(YAML_PATH.read_text())
        current.pop(trial.CONFIG_GROUP)
        current.pop("qsa_select_paged_prefill_stage_joint_score", None)
        # Pin all pre-existing groups without requiring history in shallow GPU clones.
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(current, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
            "1aa96c1a0a404907a739e4a34921525e3b039ea11f4cc3eb3b58236856b7c7da",
        )
        a, b = self.configs()
        trial.validate_configs(a, b)
        for index in range(17):
            wrong = copy.deepcopy(b)
            wrong[index].values["K_TILES"] += 1
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                trial.validate_configs(a, wrong)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            trial.validate_configs(a, b[:-1])
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            trial.validate_configs(a, a)

    def test_factory_reuses_exact_combined_jit_and_host_with_independent_entry(self):
        old, new = self.configs()
        jit = object()
        template = types.SimpleNamespace(configs=old, keys=["rows"], fn=jit)
        production = types.SimpleNamespace(
            persistent_topk=object(), _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=Entry(template)
        )
        module = types.ModuleType("combined")
        module.__file__ = str(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py")
        module.production_baseline = production
        module.persistent_topk = production.persistent_topk
        module._qsa_prefill_score_kernel = Entry(template)
        module._qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel = object()
        module._prefill_logits = object()
        module.qsa_select_paged_prefill = object()
        compact, host = module._qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel, module._prefill_logits
        original_entry = module._qsa_prefill_score_kernel

        def libtuner(**kwargs):
            def decorate(fn):
                return types.SimpleNamespace(
                    fn=fn,
                    configs=kwargs["configs"],
                    keys=kwargs["key"],
                    prune=kwargs["prune_configs_by"],
                )

            return decorate

        package = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm")
        package.runtime = types.SimpleNamespace(get_tuned_config=lambda name: new)
        utils = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm.utils")
        utils.libtuner = libtuner
        with patch.dict(
            sys.modules, {"flaggems_vllm": package, "flaggems_vllm.utils": utils}
        ):
            with patch.object(trial.combined, "candidate_module", return_value=module):
                candidate = trial.candidate_module(production)
        e = candidate._qsa_prefill_score_kernel
        self.assertIs(e.fn.fn, jit)
        self.assertEqual(e.fn.keys, template.keys)
        self.assertIs(candidate._prefill_logits, host)
        self.assertIs(candidate._qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel, compact)
        self.assertIs(candidate.persistent_topk, production.persistent_topk)
        for other in (production._qsa_prefill_score_kernel, original_entry):
            self.assertIsNot(e, other)
            self.assertTrue(
                all(a is not b for a, b in zip(e.kernel_cache, other.kernel_cache))
            )
        m = trial.metadata(candidate, [])
        self.assertEqual(m["kernel_sha256"], trial.KERNEL_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(m["num_stages"], 1)
        self.assertTrue(m["same_topk"])
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            trial.metadata(candidate, [dict(constexprs=dict(num_stages=2))])
        candidate.loop_stage_choices.pop()
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            trial.metadata(candidate, [])

    def test_unchanged_math_source_and_previous_baseline_factory(self):
        kernel = ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py"
        production = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py"
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(kernel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), trial.KERNEL_SHA256
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(production.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256
        )
        canonical = object()
        module = types.SimpleNamespace(production_baseline=canonical)
        with patch.object(
            trial.combined,
            "candidate_module",
            return_value=types.SimpleNamespace(__file__=str(kernel)),
        ) as factory:
            self.assertEqual(
                cache.previous_module(module, "combined").__file__, str(kernel)
            )
            factory.assert_called_once_with(canonical)
        self.assertEqual(
            cache.previous_identity("combined")["baseline_kind"], trial.BASELINE_KIND
        )

    def summary(self):
        s = combined_tests.CombinedTests.summary()
        s["manifest"]["options"].update(
            candidate="query-loop-stage",
            compare_previous_tuning=True,
            previous_tuning="combined",
        )
        _, choices = self.configs()
        for c in s["cases"]:
            for t in c.get("cache_granularity", {}).get("production", []):
                t["constants"]["num_stages"] = 1
            c["loop_stage"] = dict(
                config_group=trial.CONFIG_GROUP,
                kernel_sha256=trial.KERNEL_SHA256,
                num_stages=1,
                same_topk=True,
                configs=copy.deepcopy(c["production_score_configs"]),
                choices=[x.all_kwargs() for x in choices],
            )
            c["previous_tuning"] = dict(
                cache.previous_identity("combined"), same_topk=True
            )
            for stage in ("score", "pipeline"):
                entry = copy.deepcopy(c["stages"][stage])
                entry.update(
                    baseline_kind=trial.BASELINE_KIND, includes_topk=stage == "pipeline"
                )
                c["stages"][stage + "_vs_previous_tuning"] = entry
        return s

    def test_acceptance_requires_measured_combined_baseline_and_stage1_evidence(self):
        s = self.summary()
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(s)
        result = trial.acceptance(s)
        self.assertEqual(s, snapshot)
        self.assertTrue(result["measurement_valid"] and result["target_met"])
        self.assertEqual(result["candidate"], "query-loop-stage")
        self.assertFalse(result["formal_production_acceptance"])
        for key in (
            "num_stages",
            "choices",
            "same_topk",
            "configs",
            "kernel_sha256",
            "config_group",
        ):
            bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
            bad["cases"][0]["loop_stage"].pop(key)
            self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        for name in ("score_vs_previous_tuning", "pipeline_vs_previous_tuning"):
            bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
            bad["cases"][0]["stages"].pop(name)
            self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
        bad["cases"][0]["loop_stage"]["choices"][0]["num_stages"] = 2
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
        bad["manifest"]["options"]["compare_previous_tuning"] = False
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])

    def test_iteration_and_full_coverage_match_rebound_gpu_nodes(self):
        nodes = profiles.expected_nodes("query-loop-stage")
        self.assertEqual(len(nodes), 62)
        self.assertEqual(sum(profiles.LOOP_STAGE_FILE in n for n in nodes), 22)
        records = {n: dict(result="passed") for n in nodes}
        self.assertIsNone(profiles.validate(records, "query-loop-stage"))
        every = next(n for n in nodes if "every_config" in n)
        for status in ("skipped", "failed"):
            bad = copy.deepcopy(records)
            bad[every]["result"] = status
            self.assertIsNotNone(profiles.validate(bad, "query-loop-stage"))
        prefix = profiles.LOOP_STAGE_FILE + "::"
        full = {k: v for k, v in records.items() if k.startswith(prefix)}
        for family, count in (
            ("test_combined_compact_every_config", 6),
            ("test_combined_full_entry", 12),
        ):
            full.update(
                {
                    prefix + family + f"[{i}]": dict(result="passed")
                    for i in range(count)
                }
            )
        self.assertIsNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(full))
        full.pop(every)
        self.assertIsNotNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(full))
        tree = ast.parse((ROOT / profiles.LOOP_STAGE_FILE).read_text())
        forced = [
            n
            for n in ast.walk(tree)
            if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
            and ast.unparse(n).startswith("kw['num_stages']")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(forced), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(ast.literal_eval(n.value) == 1 for n in forced))

    def test_cli_sources_and_runner_preserve_frozen_set_and_two_rounds(self):
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            str(Path(bench.__file__)),
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "query-loop-stage",
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--compare-previous-tuning",
            "--previous-tuning",
            "combined",
        ]
        p = subprocess.run(command + ["--list-cases"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0, p.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(len(json.loads(p.stdout)), 30)
        p = subprocess.run(
            command + ["--list-accuracy-tests"], capture_output=True, text=True
        )
        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0, p.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(len(json.loads(p.stdout)["targets"]), 62)
        runner = (ROOT / "tools/run_qsa_prefill_loop_stage_h800.sh").read_text()
        self.assertIn("--rounds 2", runner)
        self.assertIn("--accuracy-profile iteration", runner)
        self.assertNotIn("--cases", runner)
        self.assertNotIn("control-cycles", runner)
        self.assertIn("tools/qsa_prefill_loop_stage_trial.py", bench.SOURCES)
        self.assertIn(profiles.LOOP_STAGE_FILE, bench.SOURCES)
        # No timer/guard/validation helper was replaced to add the candidate.
        tree = ast.parse(Path(bench.__file__).read_text())
        report = next(
            n
            for n in tree.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "write_table"
        )
        text = ast.unparse(report)
        self.assertLess(
            text.index("loop_stage.acceptance"),
            text.index("accuracy_profiles.annotate_acceptance"),
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""CPU gates for the sole loop transform and the frozen joint-stage baseline."""

import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_accuracy_profiles as profiles
from tools import qsa_prefill_cache_granularity as cache
from tools import qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_trial as trial
from tools import qsa_prefill_stage_joint_trial as joint
from tools import test_qsa_prefill_stage_joint as joint_tests

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class UnrollTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_kernel_transform_and_source_pins(self):
        old = (ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py").read_text()
        new = (ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_kernel.py").read_text()
        self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(old.encode()).hexdigest(), joint.KERNEL_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(new.encode()).hexdigest(), trial.KERNEL_SHA256)
        a, b = ast.parse(old), ast.parse(new)
        a.body[0] = copy.deepcopy(b.body[0])  # Module docstring only.
        fn_a, fn_b = [
            next(n for n in t.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)) for t in (a, b)
        ]
        fn_a.decorator_list = copy.deepcopy(fn_b.decorator_list)
        loop_a = next(n for n in fn_a.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
        loop_b = next(n for n in fn_b.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
        self.assertEqual(ast.unparse(loop_a.iter), "range(first_tile, last_tile)")
        self.assertEqual(
            ast.unparse(loop_b.iter),
            "tl.range(first_tile, last_tile, loop_unroll_factor=2)",
        )
        loop_b.iter = copy.deepcopy(loop_a.iter)
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(a), ast.dump(b))
        # Unroll factor is fixed; no tunable/contract parameter was added.
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(fn_a.args), ast.dump(fn_b.args))

    def test_factory_new_jit_same_host_choices_topk_and_isolated_entry(self):
        old, choices = joint_tests.StageJointTests().configs()
        old_jit, new_jit = object(), object()
        template = types.SimpleNamespace(configs=old, keys=["rows"], fn=old_jit)
        production = types.SimpleNamespace(
            _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=joint_tests.Entry(template),
            persistent_topk=object(),
        )
        module = types.ModuleType("combined")
        module.__file__ = str(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py")
        module.production_baseline = production
        module.persistent_topk = production.persistent_topk
        module._qsa_prefill_score_kernel = joint_tests.Entry(template)
        module._prefill_logits = object()
        module.qsa_select_paged_prefill = object()
        module._qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel = object()
        host, compact = module._prefill_logits, module._qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel
        kernel = types.ModuleType("tools.qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_kernel")
        kernel.__file__ = str(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_kernel.py")
        kernel._qsa_prefill_score_kernel = joint_tests.Entry(
            types.SimpleNamespace(fn=new_jit)
        )
        pkg = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm")
        pkg.runtime = types.SimpleNamespace(get_tuned_config=lambda name: choices)
        utils = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm.utils")
        utils.libtuner = lambda **kw: lambda fn: types.SimpleNamespace(
            fn=fn, configs=kw["configs"], keys=kw["key"]
        )
        with patch.dict(
            sys.modules,
            {
                "flaggems_vllm": pkg,
                "flaggems_vllm.utils": utils,
                "tools.qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_kernel": kernel,
            },
        ), patch.object(trial.combined, "candidate_module", return_value=module):
            candidate = trial.candidate_module(production)
        self.assertIs(candidate._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.fn.fn, new_jit)
        self.assertIs(candidate._prefill_logits, host)
        self.assertIs(candidate._qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel, compact)
        self.assertIs(candidate.persistent_topk, production.persistent_topk)
        self.assertEqual(candidate._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.fn.configs, choices)
        self.assertTrue(
            all(
                a is not b
                for a, b in zip(
                    candidate._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.kernel_cache,
                    production._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.kernel_cache,
                )
            )
        )
        info = trial.metadata(candidate, [dict(constexprs=choices[17].all_kwargs())])
        self.assertEqual(info["loop_unroll_factor"], 2)
        self.assertTrue(info["same_topk"])
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            trial.metadata(candidate, [dict(constexprs=dict(num_stages=3))])

    def test_previous_factory_is_exact_joint_stage(self):
        canonical = object()
        module = types.SimpleNamespace(production_baseline=canonical)
        with patch.object(joint, "candidate_module", return_value=canonical) as factory:
            self.assertIs(cache.previous_module(module, "stage-joint"), canonical)
            factory.assert_called_once_with(canonical)
        self.assertEqual(
            cache.previous_identity("stage-joint"),
            dict(
                source_equivalent_sha256=joint.KERNEL_SHA256,
                config_group=joint.CONFIG_GROUP,
                baseline_kind=trial.BASELINE_KIND,
            ),
        )

    def summary(self):
        s = joint_tests.StageJointTests().summary()
        s["manifest"]["options"].update(
            candidate="query-loop-unroll", previous_tuning="stage-joint"
        )
        for c in s["cases"]:
            m = c.pop("stage_joint")
            m.update(kernel_sha256=trial.KERNEL_SHA256, loop_unroll_factor=2)
            c["loop_unroll"] = m
            c["previous_tuning"].update(cache.previous_identity("stage-joint"))
            for name in ("score_vs_previous_tuning", "pipeline_vs_previous_tuning"):
                c["stages"][name]["baseline_kind"] = trial.BASELINE_KIND
        return s

    def test_acceptance_rejects_wrong_baseline_and_changed_transform(self):
        s = self.summary()
        result = trial.acceptance(s)
        self.assertTrue(result["measurement_valid"], result)
        self.assertEqual(result["candidate"], "query-loop-unroll")
        self.assertFalse(result["formal_production_acceptance"])
        for field, value in [
            ("loop_unroll_factor", 1),
            ("kernel_sha256", joint.KERNEL_SHA256),
            ("same_topk", False),
        ]:
            bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
            bad["cases"][0]["loop_unroll"][field] = value
            self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        for field, value in [
            ("baseline_kind", joint.BASELINE_KIND),
            ("config_group", "wrong"),
            ("source_equivalent_sha256", trial.KERNEL_SHA256),
        ]:
            bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
            bad["cases"][0]["previous_tuning"][field] = value
            self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
        bad["manifest"]["options"]["previous_tuning"] = "combined"
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])

    def test_report_table_preserves_stage_data_and_private_acceptance(self):
        summary = self.summary()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            target = Path(directory)
            bench.write_table(summary, target)
            table = (target / "triton-stage-ab.tsv").read_text()
            self.assertIn("gems_loop_unroll_trial_us", table.splitlines()[0])
            self.assertIn("\ttopk\t", table)
            self.assertIn("\tpipeline\t", table)
            result = json.loads((target / "overall-acceptance.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(result["candidate"], "query-loop-unroll")
            self.assertTrue(result["measurement_valid"])
            self.assertFalse(result["formal_production_acceptance"])

    def test_iteration_full_coverage_and_gpu_forced_paths(self):
        nodes = profiles.expected_nodes("query-loop-unroll")
        self.assertEqual(len(nodes), 62)
        records = {n: dict(result="passed") for n in nodes}
        self.assertIsNone(profiles.validate(records, "query-loop-unroll"))
        selected = {k: v for k, v in records.items() if profiles.LOOP_UNROLL_FILE in k}
        for family, count in [
            ("test_combined_compact_every_config", 6),
            ("test_combined_full_entry", 12),
        ]:
            selected.update(
                {
                    profiles.LOOP_UNROLL_FILE
                    + "::"
                    + family
                    + f"[{i}]": dict(result="passed")
                    for i in range(count)
                }
            )
        self.assertIsNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(selected))
        selected.pop(next(iter(selected)))
        self.assertIsNotNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(selected))
        old = (ROOT / profiles.STAGE_JOINT_FILE).read_text()
        new = (ROOT / profiles.LOOP_UNROLL_FILE).read_text()
        a = ast.parse(
            old.replace(
                "qsa_prefill_stage_joint_trial", "qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_trial"
            )
        )
        b = ast.parse(new)
        a.body[0] = copy.deepcopy(b.body[0])
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(a), ast.dump(b))
        self.assertEqual(new.count("itertools.product((2, 1), modes)"), 3)
        self.assertIn("configs=configs", new)

    def test_cli_runner_archive_and_baseline_restrictions(self):
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            str(Path(bench.__file__)),
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "query-loop-unroll",
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--compare-previous-tuning",
            "--previous-tuning",
            "stage-joint",
        ]
        for flag, count in [("--list-cases", 30), ("--list-accuracy-tests", 62)]:
            p = subprocess.run(command + [flag], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0, p.stderr)
            data = json.loads(p.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(
                len(data if flag == "--list-cases" else data["targets"]), count
            )
        bad = list(command)
        bad[-1] = "combined"
        self.assertEqual(
            subprocess.run(bad + ["--list-cases"], capture_output=True).returncode, 2
        )
        runner = (ROOT / "tools/run_qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_h800.sh").read_text()
        self.assertIn("--rounds 2", runner)
        self.assertIn("--previous-tuning stage-joint", runner)
        self.assertNotIn("--cases", runner)
        for path in [
            "tools/qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_trial.py",
            "tools/qsa_prefill_loop_unroll_kernel.py",
            profiles.LOOP_UNROLL_FILE,
