# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Copyright 2026 FlagOS Contributors
"""CPU contracts and execution of the actual Triton scheduler's scalar prefix."""

import argparse
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import yaml

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_packed_grid as trial
from tools import test_qsa_prefill_tuning_round1 as tuning_tests

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py"
KERNEL = ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_packed_grid_kernel.py"


def function(tree, name):
    return next(
        n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name
    )


class Pointer:
    def __init__(self, values, index=0):
        self.values, self.index = values, index

    def __add__(self, offset):
        return Pointer(self.values, self.index + offset)


class PackedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_diagnostics_count_query_slots_without_claiming_flops(self):
        args = [
            types.SimpleNamespace(shape=(160, 4, 128)),
            None,
            types.SimpleNamespace(shape=(4, 6)),
            None,
            None,
            None,
            None,
            80,
        ]
        trace = dict(
            offset=0,
            rows=160,
            width=1088,
            route="packed",
            constants=dict(TILE_R=32, BLOCK_N=64, K_TILES=4),
        )
        result = trial.diagnostics(args, [trace], [80, 80, 0, 0])[0]
        self.assertEqual(
            (
                result["rectangular_query_slots"],
                result["packed_query_slots"],
                result["useful_query_slots"],
                result["empty_query_slots"],
                result["issued_programs"],
            ),
            (12, 9, 6, 3, 45),
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "fixture geometry"):
            trial.diagnostics(args, [trace], [80, 80])

    def test_only_scheduler_and_launcher_routing_differ(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256
        )
        production, candidate = ast.parse(SOURCE.read_text()), ast.parse(
            KERNEL.read_text()
        )
        old, new = function(production, "_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"), function(
            candidate, "_qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel"
        )
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(old.args), ast.dump(new.args))
        self.assertEqual(
            [ast.dump(n) for n in old.decorator_list],
            [ast.dump(n) for n in new.decorator_list],
        )

        def arithmetic(node):
            index = next(
                i
                for i, n in enumerate(node.body)
                if isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and n.target.id == "HEADS_PADDED"
            )
            return [ast.dump(n) for n in node.body[index:]]

        self.assertEqual(arithmetic(old), arithmetic(new))
        oldh, newh = function(production, "_prefill_logits"), function(
            candidate, "_prefill_logits"
        )
        # Remove just the extra elif; every other host statement must match.
        chain = next(
            n
            for n in newh.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.If)
            and isinstance(n.test, ast.Name)
            and n.test.id == "compact"
        )
        self.assertEqual(chain.orelse[0].test.func.id, "_packed_eligible")
        chain.orelse = chain.orelse[0].orelse
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(oldh), ast.dump(newh))
        groups = yaml.safe_load(
            (
                ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_nvidia/tune_configs.yaml"
            ).read_text()
        )
        configs = groups["qsa_select_paged_prefill_tuning_round1_score"]
        self.assertEqual(len(configs), 10)
        self.assertEqual(max(c["META"]["TILE_R"] for c in configs), trial.MAX_TILE_R)

    def test_actual_scalar_mapping_covers_every_request_tile_once(self):
        node = function(
            ast.parse(KERNEL.read_text()), "_qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel"
        )
        end = next(
            i
            for i, n in enumerate(node.body)
            if isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and n.target.id == "HEADS_PADDED"
        )
        prefix = copy.deepcopy(node.body[:end]) + [
            ast.parse("return request,row_start,request_end").body[0]
        ]
        args = ast.arguments(
            posonlyargs=[],
            args=[
                ast.arg(arg=n)
                for n in (
                    "starts_ptr",
                    "query_offset",
                    "num_rows",
                    "num_requests",
                    "TILE_R",
                    "tl",
                )
            ],
            kwonlyargs=[],
            kw_defaults=[],
            defaults=[],
        )
        fun = ast.FunctionDef(name="mapping", args=args, body=prefix, decorator_list=[])
        env = {}
        exec(
            compile(
                ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[fun], type_ignores=[])),
                str(KERNEL),
                "exec",
            ),
            env,
        )
        definitions = []
        for case in bench.workloads.cases("combined-prefill"):
            g = bench.workloads.geometry(case)
            offset = 0
            for rows in g["expected_chunk_rows"]:
                definitions.append((g["query_lengths"], offset, rows))
                offset += rows
        rng = random.Random(20261021)
        for _ in range(100):
            lengths = [rng.randrange(0, 80) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 9))]
            if not sum(lengths):
                continue
            offset = rng.randrange(sum(lengths))
            rows = rng.randrange(1, sum(lengths) - offset + 1)
            definitions.append((lengths, offset, rows))
        for lengths, offset, rows in definitions:
            starts = [97]
            for n in lengths:
                starts.append(starts[-1] + n)
            for tile in (4, 8, 16, 32, 64):
                expected = []
                for req, (begin, end) in enumerate(zip(starts, starts[1:])):
                    begin, end = max(begin - 97, offset), min(end - 97, offset + rows)
                    expected += [(req, start, end) for start in range(begin, end, tile)]
                actual = []
                for slot in range(rows // tile + len(lengths)):
                    tl = types.SimpleNamespace(
                        program_id=lambda axis: slot,
                        load=lambda ptr: ptr.values[ptr.index],
                        minimum=min,
                        maximum=max,
                    )
                    result = env["mapping"](
                        Pointer(starts), offset, rows, len(lengths), tile, tl
                    )
                    if result is not None:
                        actual.append(result)
                self.assertEqual(
                    sorted(actual), expected, (lengths, offset, rows, tile)
                )

    def test_policy_selects_only_profitable_metadata_cases(self):
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(1, 16384, 4519))
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(2, 16000, 64))
        self.assertTrue(trial.eligible(4, 4096, 5041))
        self.assertTrue(trial.eligible(2, 10375, 73))
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(4, 4096, 16384))
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(0, 0, 0))
        selected = []
        gate = function(ast.parse(SOURCE.read_text()), "_compact_eligible")
        env = {}
        exec(
            compile(
                ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[gate], type_ignores=[])),
                str(SOURCE),
                "exec",
            ),
            env,
        )
        for case in bench.workloads.cases("scored-prefill"):
            g = bench.workloads.geometry(case)
            n = len(g["query_lengths"])
            maximum = max(g["query_lengths"])
            if any(
                not env["_compact_eligible"](sum(g["query_lengths"]), n, maximum, r)
                and trial.eligible(n, maximum, r)
                for r in g["expected_chunk_rows"]
            ):
                selected.append(case["name"])
        self.assertEqual(len(selected), 6)

    def test_trial_factory_preserves_public_host_topk_and_cache_alignment(self):
        class Entry:
            def __init__(self, fn):
                self.fn, self.kernel_cache = fn, ({},)

        production = types.ModuleType("production")
        production.__file__ = str(SOURCE)
        production.persistent_topk = object()
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel"):
            setattr(
                production,
                name,
                Entry(
                    types.SimpleNamespace(configs=[1], keys=["num_rows"], fn=object())
                ),
            )
        exec(
            "def qsa_select_paged_prefill():\n return _prefill_logits(),persistent_topk\n",
            vars(production),
        )
        kernel = types.ModuleType("tools.qsa_prefill_packed_grid_kernel")
        kernel.__file__ = str(KERNEL)
        kernel._qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel = Entry(
            types.SimpleNamespace(configs=[1], keys=["num_rows"], fn=object())
        )
        exec(
            "def _prefill_logits():\n return _qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel,_packed_eligible\n",
            vars(kernel),
        )
        utils = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm.utils")
        utils.libtuner = lambda **kwargs: lambda jit: types.SimpleNamespace(
            fn=jit, configs=kwargs["configs"], keys=kwargs["key"]
        )
        with patch.dict(
            sys.modules,
            {
                "flaggems_vllm.utils": utils,
                "tools.qsa_prefill_packed_grid_kernel": kernel,
            },
        ):
            candidate = trial.candidate_module(production)
        self.assertIs(candidate.production_baseline, production)
        self.assertIs(
            candidate.qsa_select_paged_prefill.__code__,
            production.qsa_select_paged_prefill.__code__,
        )
        self.assertIs(
            candidate.qsa_select_paged_prefill()[1], production.persistent_topk
        )
        self.assertIs(candidate._prefill_logits()[1], trial.eligible)
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel"):
            self.assertIs(
                type(getattr(candidate, name)), type(getattr(production, name))
            )
            self.assertIsNot(
                getattr(candidate, name).kernel_cache[0],
                getattr(production, name).kernel_cache[0],
            )
            self.assertIs(
                getattr(candidate, name).fn.fn, getattr(production, name).fn.fn
            )

    def test_experimental_acceptance_requires_baseline_pin_and_both_comparisons(self):
        s = tuning_tests.AcceptanceTests.summary()
        s["manifest"]["options"].update(
            candidate="packed-grid", compare_previous_tuning=False
        )
        for c in s["cases"]:
            c["runtime"] = {
                "operator_binding": {"canonical_sha256": trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256}
            }
            for name in ("score_vs_production", "pipeline_vs_production"):
                c["stages"][name] = copy.deepcopy(c["stages"]["pipeline"])
        r = trial.acceptance(s)
        self.assertTrue(
            r["measurement_valid"] and r["target_met"] and r["experimental"]
        )
        self.assertFalse(r["formal_production_acceptance"])
        for mutate in (
            lambda x: x["cases"][0]["stages"].pop("pipeline_vs_production"),
            lambda x: x["cases"][0]["runtime"]["operator_binding"].update(
                canonical_sha256="wrong"
            ),
            lambda x: x["manifest"]["options"].update(shared_gpu_exploratory=True),
        ):
            copy_s = copy.deepcopy(s)
            mutate(copy_s)
            r = trial.acceptance(copy_s)
            self.assertFalse(r["measurement_valid"])
            self.assertIsNone(r["target_met"])

    def test_cli_and_worker_preserve_trial_and_kernel_profile(self):
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            "-I",
            str(Path(bench.__file__)),
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "packed-grid",
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--list-cases",
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(result.stdout), bench.workloads.cases("scored-prefill")
        )
        command[command.index("flagtree")] = "stock"
        self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)
        options = argparse.Namespace(
            compiler="flagtree",
            flagtree="/opt/flagtree",
            candidate="packed-grid",
            suite="scored-prefill",
            reference_file="native.py",
            rounds=2,
            kernel_warmup_ms=200,
            kernel_rep_ms=100,
        )
        child = bench.child_command(options, Path("/tmp/report"), "--worker")
        self.assertEqual(child[child.index("--candidate") + 1], "packed-grid")
        self.assertEqual(child[child.index("--rounds") + 1], "2")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Prove dtype scope is the only difference from the earlier page-table trial."""

import ast
import copy
import unittest

from tools import test_qsa_prefill_page_table as common

KERNEL = common.ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_page_table_bf16_kernel.py"


class BF16PageTableTests(common.PageTableTests):
    kernel = KERNEL
    bf16_only = True

    def test_only_new_change_is_the_constexpr_dtype_gate(self):
        old = common.score(ast.parse(common.KERNEL.read_text()))
        new = common.score(ast.parse(KERNEL.read_text()))
        old_loop = next(n for n in old.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
        new_loop = next(n for n in new.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
        old_branch = next(n for n in old_loop.body if isinstance(n, ast.If))
        new_branch = next(n for n in new_loop.body if isinstance(n, ast.If))
        self.assertEqual(
            ast.dump(new_branch.test),
            ast.dump(
                ast.parse("not IS_FP8 and BLOCK_N <= PAGE_SIZE", mode="eval").body
            ),
        )
        # Specialize the constexpr gate: FP8 recovers the exact old vector
        # lookup; BF16 recovers the measured scalar/general branch unchanged.
        for fp8 in (False, True):
            condition = compile(ast.Expression(new_branch.test), "condition", "eval")
            for block, page in ((64, 196), (128, 196), (128, 16)):
                selected = eval(
                    condition, dict(IS_FP8=fp8, BLOCK_N=block, PAGE_SIZE=page)
                )
                self.assertEqual(selected, not fp8 and block <= page)
        new_branch.test = copy.deepcopy(old_branch.test)
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(new), ast.dump(old))

    def test_actual_fp8_vector_lookup_at_all_live_columns(self):
        self.fp8 = True
        self.test_actual_load_branch_matches_vector_lookup_at_all_live_columns()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""Integration contracts: retained kernels, real dispatch, public identity."""

import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import os
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import test_qsa_prefill_chunk_setup as chunk

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_observed_workloads as workloads
from tools import qsa_prefill_triton_ab as ab

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRODUCTION = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py"
FROZEN = ROOT / ab.FROZEN_PRODUCTION_PATH


def functions(path):
    return {
        n.name: n
        for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
    }


def retained_host():
    # Execute the actual retained trial launcher over the old public host body,
    # with capture-only kernels. No implementation of routing is mirrored here.
    ns, calls, topks, allocations = chunk.load(FROZEN)
    ns["_production_prefill_logits"] = ns["_prefill_logits"]
    tree = functions(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_compact_trial.py")
    exec(
        compile(
            ast.Module(
                body=[tree["_compact_eligible"], tree["_prefill_logits"]],
                type_ignores=[],
            ),
            "retained_compact_host",
            "exec",
        ),
        ns,
    )
    return ns, calls, topks, allocations


class ProductionIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_kernels_and_gate_are_exact_transfers(self):
        current = functions(PRODUCTION)
        old = functions(FROZEN)
        rect = copy.deepcopy(
            functions(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_key_major_trial.py")[
                "_qsa_prefill_key_major_score_kernel"
            ]
        )
        rect.name = "_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"
        # Config selection and the operator-local outer cache decorator differ;
        # kernel arithmetic, signature, keys and JIT specialization are exact.
        rect.decorator_list[0] = ast.Name(id="_QSAScoreEntry", ctx=ast.Load())
        for node in ast.walk(rect.decorator_list[1]):
            if (
                isinstance(node, ast.Constant)
                and node.value == "qsa_select_paged_prefill_score"
            ):
                node.value = "qsa_select_paged_prefill_tuning_round1_score"
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(rect), ast.dump(current[rect.name]))
        compact = functions(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_compact_trial.py")
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel", "_compact_eligible"):
            self.assertEqual(ast.dump(current[name]), ast.dump(compact[name]))
        for name in old.keys() - {"_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_prefill_logits"}:
            self.assertEqual(ast.dump(current[name]), ast.dump(old[name]), name)
        self.assertNotIn("eviction_policy", PRODUCTION.read_text())

    def test_pins_exports_and_no_production_dependency_on_trials(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(FROZEN.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), ab.PRODUCTION_SHA256
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(PRODUCTION.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            ab.INTEGRATED_PRODUCTION_SHA256,
        )
        tree = ast.parse(PRODUCTION.read_text())
        imports = [
            n.module or "" for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom)
        ]
        self.assertTrue(all(not s.startswith(("tools", "tests")) for s in imports))
        for path in (
            ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/__init__.py",
            ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/__init__.py",
        ):
            self.assertIn("qsa_select_paged_prefill", path.read_text())
        # All changed device arithmetic exactly matches reviewed trial ASTs;
        # host/public validation and allocation bodies are unchanged above.
        self.assertEqual(
            {
                n.func.attr
                for n in ast.walk(tree)
                if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
                and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute)
                and isinstance(n.func.value, ast.Name)
                and n.func.value.id == "torch"
            },
            {"empty"},
        )

    def test_actual_production_dispatch_matches_retained_host_on_all32(self):
        routed = []
        for case in workloads.cases("combined-prefill"):
            info = workloads.geometry(case)
            with self.subTest(case=case["name"]):
                outputs = []
                for loader in (chunk.load, retained_host):
                    ns, calls, topks, allocations = loader()
                    rows = info["q_shape"][0]
                    shapes = [
                        info["q_shape"],
                        info["cache_shape"],
                        info["page_table_shape"],
                        [len(info["query_lengths"]) + 1],
                        [rows],
                        [rows, 512],
                    ]
                    tensors = [
                        chunk.Array(
                            s,
                            (
                                ("fp8" if case["dtype"] == "float8_e4m3fn" else "bf16")
                                if i < 2
                                else "i32"
                            ),
                            # Detailed FP8 caches exceed the former10MB gap.
                            # Fake independent allocations must not alias.
                            (i + 1) * (1 << 40),
                            label=f"input_{i}",
                        )
                        for i, s in enumerate(shapes)
                    ]
                    args = [
                        *tensors[:5],
                        2048,
                        4,
                        max(info["query_lengths"]),
                        tensors[5],
                        max(info["sequence_lengths"]),
                    ]
                    with patch.dict(
                        os.environ, VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB="512"
                    ):
                        self.assertIsNone(ns["qsa_select_paged_prefill"](*args))
                    outputs.append(
                        (
                            calls,
                            [(tuple(map(chunk.normalize, a)), kw) for a, kw in topks],
                            [chunk.normalize(a) for a in allocations],
                        )
                    )
                    if (
                        loader is chunk.load
                        and any(
                            ns["_compact_eligible"](
                                rows, len(info["query_lengths"]), args[7], n
                            )
                            for n in info["expected_chunk_rows"]
                        )
                        and not info.get("select_all", False)
                    ):
                        routed.append(case["name"])
                self.assertEqual(outputs[0], outputs[1])
        self.assertEqual(
            routed, ["observed_ragged54_bfloat16", "fp8_compact_float8_e4m3fn"]
        )

    def test_chunked_and_strided_host_transfer(self):
        for rows, requests, maximum in ((73, 2, 39), (200, 8, 100), (50, 8, 33)):
            for dtype in ("bf16", "fp8"):
                for padded in (False, True):
                    for budget in ("512", "1", "0"):
                        with self.subTest(
                            rows=rows,
                            requests=requests,
                            dtype=dtype,
                            padded=padded,
                            budget=budget,
                        ):
                            outputs = []
                            for loader in (chunk.load, retained_host):
                                ns, calls, topks, allocations = loader()
                                args = chunk.inputs(
                                    rows=rows, dtype=dtype, padded=padded
                                )
                                args[2] = chunk.Array(
                                    (requests, 512),
                                    "i32",
                                    30000000,
                                    (2048, 2),
                                    label="input_2",
                                )
                                args[3] = chunk.Array(
                                    (requests + 1,), "i32", 40000000, label="input_3"
                                )
                                args[7] = maximum
                                with patch.dict(
                                    os.environ, VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB=budget
                                ):
                                    ns["qsa_select_paged_prefill"](*args)
                                outputs.append(
                                    (
                                        calls,
                                        [
                                            (tuple(map(chunk.normalize, a)), kw)
                                            for a, kw in topks
                                        ],
                                        [chunk.normalize(a) for a in allocations],
                                    )
                                )
                            self.assertEqual(outputs[0], outputs[1])

    def test_public_binding_rejects_clone_wrong_export_or_changed_source(self):
        op = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm.ops.qsa_select_paged_prefill")
        op.__file__ = str(PRODUCTION)
        exec("def qsa_select_paged_prefill(): pass", vars(op))
        binding = bench.operator_binding(
            op, op, op.qsa_select_paged_prefill, require_production=True
        )
        self.assertTrue(binding["candidate_is_canonical_module"])
        clone = types.ModuleType("trial")
        clone.__dict__.update(vars(op))
        for candidate, exported in (
            (clone, op.qsa_select_paged_prefill),
            (op, lambda: None),
        ):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "actual exported entry"):
                bench.operator_binding(op, candidate, exported, require_production=True)
        with patch.object(ab, "INTEGRATED_PRODUCTION_SHA256", "changed"):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "actual exported entry"):
                bench.operator_binding(
                    op, op, op.qsa_select_paged_prefill, require_production=True
                )

    def test_production_accuracy_worker_uses_official_file_and_identity_checks(self):
        fn = functions(Path(bench.__file__))["accuracy_worker"]
        ns = dict(bench.__dict__)
        calls = []
        from tools.qsa_prefill_score_resume import RUNTIME_KEYS

        info = {k: "fixed" for k in RUNTIME_KEYS}
        info["operator_binding"] = {"candidate_is_canonical_module": True}
        ns["runtime"] = lambda *a, **kw: (info,)
        ns["support"] = types.SimpleNamespace(write_json=lambda *a: None)
        exec(
            compile(ast.Module(body=[fn], type_ignores=[]), "accuracy_worker", "exec"),
            ns,
        )
        pytest = types.SimpleNamespace(main=lambda args: calls.append(args) or 0)
        for candidate in (
            "production",
            "packed-grid",
            "page-table",
            "page-table-bf16",
            "query-split",
            "query-joint",

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""Diagnostic orchestration: never pass profiler samples as benchmark results."""

import contextlib
import copy
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_profiling as profiling


class ProfilingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def options(self, root):
        return types.SimpleNamespace(
            cases=list(profiling.CASES),
            report_dir=str(root),
            flagtree="/opt/flagtree",
            timeout=1800,
            ncu=None,
            worker=profiling.CASES[0],
            rounds=2,
        )

    def record(self):
        trace = dict(
            offset=0,
            rows=17,
            width=100,
            route="rectangular",
            constants=dict(TILE_R=32),
            compiled=dict(cubin_sha256="abc"),
        )
        return dict(
            status="passed",
            runtime={},
            inputs=["same"],
            chunks=[dict(rows=17)],
            kernel_resources=dict(
                native=dict(status="collected", kernels=[dict(cubin_sha256="native")])
            ),
            cache_granularity=dict(production=[trace], production_baseline=[trace]),
        )

    def test_representatives_are_existing_scored_cases(self):
        cases = {x["name"] for x in bench.workloads.cases("scored-prefill")}
        self.assertEqual(len(profiling.CASES), 5)
        self.assertTrue(set(profiling.CASES) <= cases)

    def test_capture_does_not_wrap_timing_autotune_or_topk(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            options = self.options(root)
            measured = self.record()
            (root / (options.worker + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(measured))
            calls = []
            cudart = types.SimpleNamespace(
                cudaProfilerStart=lambda: calls.append("start") or 0,
                cudaProfilerStop=lambda: calls.append("stop") or 0,
            )
            torch = types.SimpleNamespace(
                cuda=types.SimpleNamespace(
                    cudart=lambda: cudart,
                    nvtx=types.SimpleNamespace(
                        range_push=lambda x: calls.append(x), range_pop=lambda: None
                    ),
                )
            )
            device = types.SimpleNamespace(synchronize=lambda: None)

            def fn(side):
                return lambda: calls.append(side)

            functions = dict(
                score=dict(baseline=fn("native"), candidate=fn("candidate")),
                score_vs_production=dict(baseline=fn("production")),
            )
            result = copy.deepcopy(measured)
            with patch.object(bench, "runtime_identity", return_value={}):
                profiling.capture(
                    options,
                    result,
                    root / "profile.json",
                    functions,
                    lambda n: dict(passed=n),
                    torch,
                    device,
                    lambda _: None,
                )
            inside = calls[calls.index("start") + 1 : calls.index("stop")]
            self.assertEqual(
                inside,
                [
                    "qsa_score/native",
                    "native",
                    "qsa_score/production",
                    "production",
                    "qsa_score/candidate",
                    "candidate",
                ],
            )
            self.assertEqual(result["profiling"]["expected_profiled_launches"], 3)
            self.assertFalse(result["profiling"]["acceptance_eligible"])
            self.assertIn("validation_after", result["profiling"])

    def test_config_drift_rejects_before_capture(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            options = self.options(root)
            record = self.record()
            (root / (options.worker + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(record))
            changed = copy.deepcopy(record)
            changed["cache_granularity"]["production"][0]["constants"]["TILE_R"] = 64
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "differ"):
                profiling.capture(
                    options, changed, root / "p.json", {}, None, None, None, None
                )

    def test_csv_requires_metrics_not_error_text(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            path = Path(folder) / "c.csv"
            path.write_text("==ERROR== ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM\n")
            self.assertEqual(profiling.exported_metrics(path)["metric_rows"], 0)
            path.write_text(
                '==PROF== start\n"ID","Metric Name","Metric Value"\n'
                '"0","dram__bytes_read.sum","1024"\n'
                '"0","dram__bytes_write.sum","512"\n'
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                profiling.exported_metrics(path), dict(metric_rows=2, kernel_ids=["0"])
            )

    def test_raw_wide_csv_uses_unit_row_and_counts_metric_values(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            path = Path(folder) / "raw.csv"
            path.write_text(
                '==PROF== Connected\n"ID","Kernel Name","gpu__time_duration.sum",'
                '"sm__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed"\n'
                '"","","ns","%"\n"0","score","1000","0"\n"1","score","2000","n/a"\n'
            )
            normalized = profiling.read_metrics(path)
            self.assertEqual(normalized["schema"], "wide")
            self.assertEqual(normalized["units"]["gpu__time_duration.sum"], "ns")
            self.assertEqual(
                profiling.exported_metrics(path),
                dict(metric_rows=3, kernel_ids=["0", "1"]),
            )

    def test_reuse_keeps_valid_capture_and_rejects_changed_binary(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            original, previous, output = (
                root / name for name in ("original", "previous", "output")
            )
            for path in (original, previous, output):
                path.mkdir()
            name = profiling.CASES[0]
            baseline = self.record()
            baseline["case"] = dict(name=name)
            captured = copy.deepcopy(baseline)
            captured["performance_guard"] = dict(status="observed_clean")
            captured["profiling"] = dict(
                config_and_input_match=True,
                validation_before=dict(passed=True),
                validation_after=dict(passed=True),
                expected_profiled_launches=3,
                captures=[
                    dict(side=side) for side in ("native", "production", "candidate")
                ],
            )
            (original / (name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(baseline))
            capture_path = previous / ("profile-" + name + ".json")
            capture_path.write_text(json.dumps(captured))
            csv_path = previous / ("profile-" + name + ".csv")
            csv_path.write_text(
                '"ID","gpu__time_duration.sum"\n"","ns"\n0,100\n1,100\n2,100\n'
            )
            with patch.object(bench, "runtime_identity", return_value={}):
                result = profiling.reuse_profiles(original, previous, output, [name])
                self.assertEqual(result[name]["status"], "passed")
                self.assertEqual(
                    (output / csv_path.name).read_bytes(), csv_path.read_bytes()
                )
                captured["kernel_resources"]["native"]["kernels"][0][
                    "cubin_sha256"
                ] = "changed"
                capture_path.write_text(json.dumps(captured))
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "cannot be reused"):
                    profiling.reuse_profiles(original, previous, output, [name])

    def test_reused_capture_is_not_launched_again(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            options = self.options(Path(folder))
            options.cases = [profiling.CASES[0]]
            prior = dict(case=options.cases[0], status="passed", reused_from="verified")
            facts = dict(reused_profiles={options.cases[0]: prior})
            with patch.object(profiling, "find_ncu", return_value="/ncu"), patch.object(
                bench.support,
                "command",
                return_value=dict(returncode=0, stdout=" ".join(profiling.SECTIONS)),
            ), patch.object(profiling, "run_process") as launch:
                self.assertEqual(
                    profiling.collect_counters(options, facts, ["worker"]), 0
                )
            launch.assert_not_called()
            self.assertEqual(facts["profiles"], [prior])
            self.assertTrue(facts["hardware_counters_complete"])

    def test_ncu_captures_warmed_ranges_without_clock_changes(self):
        cmd = profiling.ncu_command("/ncu", Path("c.csv"), ["python", "worker"])
        self.assertEqual(cmd[-2:], ["python", "worker"])
        self.assertEqual(cmd[cmd.index("--profile-from-start") + 1], "off")
        self.assertEqual(cmd[cmd.index("--clock-control") + 1], "none")
        self.assertNotIn("--set", cmd)
        self.assertEqual(cmd.count("--section"), len(profiling.SECTIONS))

    def test_self_control_uses_identical_callable_and_original_timer(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            calls = []

            def fn():
                pass

            pair = dict(baseline=fn, candidate=fn)
            functions = {
                name: pair
                for name in (
                    "score",
                    "pipeline",
                    "score_vs_production",
                    "pipeline_vs_production",
                )
            }
            options = self.options(Path(folder))

            def timer(actual):
                self.assertIs(actual, fn)
                calls.append(actual)
                return 10.0

            result = {}
            profiling.self_controls(
                options,
                result,
                Path(folder) / "record.json",
                functions,
                timer,
                lambda _: {},
            )
            self.assertEqual(len(calls), 24)
            self.assertEqual(len(result["diagnostics"]["self_controls"]), 6)
            self.assertNotIn("stages", result)

    def test_capture_child_only_and_exclusive(self):
        base = [
            "bench",
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "query-stage-joint",
            "--compare-previous-tuning",
            "--previous-tuning",
            "combined",
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--profile-capture",
        ]
        with patch.object(os.sys, "argv", base), contextlib.redirect_stderr(
            io.StringIO()
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as error:
                bench.main()
        self.assertEqual(error.exception.code, 2)

    def test_coordinator_keeps_unprofiled_results_and_requires_counter_rows(self):
        from tools import qsa_prefill_flagtree_ab as profile
        from tools import validate_qsa_ptxas_h800 as validation

        for mode in ("passed", "missing", "permission"):
            with self.subTest(mode=mode), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                root = Path(folder)
                options = self.options(root)
                options.cases = [profiling.CASES[0]]
                commands = []

                def run(command, **kwargs):
                    commands.append(command)
                    name = options.cases[0]
                    if len(commands) == 1:
                        self.assertNotIn("--profile-capture", command)
                        self.assertNotIn("--profile-from-start", command)

                                        stage: row

                                            "score",
                                            "topk",
                                            "pipeline",
                                            "score_vs_production",

                                        )
                                    },
                                )

                        (root / "stage-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary))
                        return 0
                    self.assertIn("--profile-capture", command)
                    (root / ("profile-" + name + ".json")).write_text(
                        json.dumps(

                                status="passed",
                                profiling=dict(expected_profiled_launches=3),

                    )
                    csv_path = root / ("profile-" + name + ".csv")
                    csv_path.write_text(
                        '"ID","Metric Name","Metric Value"\n0,x,1\n1,x,2\n2,x,3\n'
                        if mode == "passed"
                        else "==ERROR== ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM\n"
                    )
                    return 0 if mode == "passed" else 1

                def command(args):
                    return dict(
                        returncode=0, stdout=" ".join(profiling.SECTIONS), stderr=""
                    )

                guard = types.SimpleNamespace(
                    idle=lambda *a, **k: dict(status="passed")
                )
                with patch.object(
                    profile, "select_gpu", return_value=True
                ), patch.object(
                    validation,
                    "toolchain",
                    return_value=dict(
                        ptxas=dict(path="/ptxas", sha256=profile.PTXAS_SHA256)

                ), patch.object(

                ), patch.object(

                ), patch.dict(
                    os.environ, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="GPU-test"
                ), contextlib.redirect_stderr(

                ):
                    rc = profiling.coordinate(options)

                saved = json.loads((root / "profiling-summary.json").read_text())

    def test_timeout_kills_only_own_process_group(self):

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Copyright 2026 FlagOS Contributors
"""CPU checks for balanced scheduling, fixed choices and shared-buffer validation."""

import contextlib
import copy
import csv
import io
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import yaml

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_query_controls as controls
from tools import qsa_prefill_query_split_matched as matched

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def trace():
    return [dict(rows=100, offset=0, width=4096, route="rectangular", constants={})]


class ControlTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_balanced_conditions_and_stage_coverage(self):
        for case, stages in ((controls.CASES[0], 1), (controls.CASES[1], 3)):
            jobs = controls.schedule(case, 4)
            self.assertEqual(len(jobs), 4 * 4 * stages)
            for condition in controls.CONDITIONS:
                positions = []
                for cycle in range(1, 5):
                    row = [j for j in jobs if j["cycle"] == cycle]
                    group = [j for j in row if j["condition"] == condition]
                    self.assertEqual(len(group), stages)
                    positions.append(row.index(group[0]) // stages)
                self.assertEqual(sorted(positions), [0, 1, 2, 3])
        transitions = [
            (a, b) for row in controls.CONDITION_ORDERS for a, b in zip(row, row[1:])
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(set(transitions)), 12)
        for case, cycles in (("unknown", 4), (controls.CASES[0], 1)):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                controls.schedule(case, cycles)

    def test_choices_are_existing_yaml_and_traces_are_not_modified(self):
        groups = yaml.safe_load(
            (
                ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_nvidia/tune_configs.yaml"
            ).read_text()
        )
        original = trace()
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(original)
        for case, joint, parts in (
            (controls.CASES[0], True, 1),
            (controls.CASES[0], True, 2),
            (controls.CASES[1], False, 1),
            (controls.CASES[1], True, 1),
        ):
            selected = controls.fixed_traces(original, case, joint=joint, parts=parts)
            group = (
                "qsa_select_paged_prefill_query_joint_score"
                if joint
                else "qsa_select_paged_prefill_tuning_round1_score"
            )
            configs = [
                types.SimpleNamespace(
                    kwargs=c["META"],
                    num_warps=c["num_warps"],
                    num_stages=c["num_stages"],
                    num_ctas=c.get("num_ctas", 1),
                )
                for c in groups[group]
            ]
            module = types.SimpleNamespace(
                _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=types.SimpleNamespace(
                    fn=types.SimpleNamespace(configs=configs)
                )
            )
            controls.assert_choice(module, selected)
            selected[0]["constants"]["K_TILES"] = 999
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                controls.assert_choice(module, selected)
        self.assertEqual(original, snapshot)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            controls.fixed_traces(original, controls.CASES[1], joint=True, parts=2)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            controls.fixed_traces([], controls.CASES[0], joint=True)

    def test_freeze_normalizes_only_mode(self):
        a, b = object(), object()
        records = {
            a: [dict(chunk=[10, 0, 64], constants=dict(TILE_R=32, QUERY_PARTS=1))],
            b: [dict(chunk=[10, 0, 64], constants=dict(TILE_R=32, QUERY_PARTS=2))],
        }
        with patch.object(
            matched,
            "freeze_and_records",
            side_effect=lambda pair: dict(baseline=records[pair[0]]),
        ):
            self.assertTrue(controls.freeze((a, b))["same_tile"])
            records[b][0]["constants"]["TILE_R"] = 64
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                controls.freeze((a, b))

    def test_pipeline_validation_checks_one_owner_at_a_time(self):
        args, chunks, native_chunks = object(), object(), object()
        fn = Mock()
        api = types.SimpleNamespace(validate_pipeline=Mock(return_value=7))
        context = (api, "torch", "helpers", "device", "native", native_chunks)
        self.assertEqual(
            controls.validate_side("pipeline", fn, None, chunks, args, context), 7
        )
        call = api.validate_pipeline.call_args.args
        self.assertEqual(call[0], dict(baseline=fn, candidate=fn))
        self.assertIs(call[1], args)
        self.assertIs(call[2], args)
        self.assertIs(call[3], native_chunks)

    def test_child_forwarding_and_restricted_cli(self):
        common = [
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "query-joint",
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--query-control-cycles",
            "4",
            "--cases",
            *controls.CASES,
        ]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            for extra, valid in (
                ([], True),
                (["--rounds", "1"], False),
                (["--shared-gpu-exploratory"], False),
                (["--query-control-cycles", "2"], False),
            ):
                with patch.object(
                    sys, "argv", ["bench", *common, "--report-dir", folder, *extra]
                ), patch.object(
                    bench, "parent", return_value=7
                ) as parent, contextlib.redirect_stderr(
                    io.StringIO()
                ):
                    if valid:
                        self.assertEqual(bench.main(), 7)
                        options, cases, _ = parent.call_args.args
                        self.assertEqual(
                            {c["name"] for c in cases}, set(controls.CASES)
                        )
                        command = bench.child_command(options, folder, "--worker")
                        self.assertEqual(
                            command[command.index("--query-control-cycles") + 1], "4"
                        )
                    else:
                        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                            bench.main()
                        parent.assert_not_called()

    def run_harness(self, case, *, fail_validation=False, change_resources=False):
        writes, validations = [], []
        topk = object()
        production = types.SimpleNamespace(name="production", persistent_topk=topk)
        candidate = types.SimpleNamespace(name="joint", persistent_topk=topk)

        class Tensor:
            shape = (4, 8)

            def __init__(self, pointer):
                self.pointer = pointer

            def stride(self):
                return (8, 1)

            def data_ptr(self):
                return self.pointer

        def chunks(bank, base):
            return [
                dict(
                    bank=bank,
                    score_args=[None] * 5 + [Tensor(base)],
                    topk_args=[None, None, Tensor(base + 1), Tensor(base + 2)],
                )
            ]

        banks = dict(a=chunks("a", 10), b=chunks("b", 20))
        owners = dict(a=object(), b=object())

        def bind(native, module, native_chunks, captured):
            result = {}
            for stage in ("score", "topk", "pipeline"):

                def launch(stage=stage):
                    writes.append((module.name, captured[0]["bank"], stage))

                result[stage] = dict(candidate=launch)
            return result

        def validate(stage, fn, module, captured, args, context):
            fn()
            bank = captured[0]["bank"]
            self.assertIs(args, owners[bank])
            self.assertEqual(writes[-1], (module.name, bank, stage))
            validations.append(writes[-1])
            # BF16 cycle1: separate and swapped occupy the first24 checks.
            # The next pair shares bank B; reject its baseline before overwrite.
            if fail_validation and len(validations) == 25:
                raise AssertionError("invalid first shared owner")
            return 3

        def timer(fn):
            fn()
            return 1.0

        api = types.SimpleNamespace(
            ab=types.SimpleNamespace(bind_stages=bind),
            scoring=types.SimpleNamespace(
                make_timer=lambda *a: (timer, dict(mode="kernel", includes_topk=False)),
                measure_scores=bench.scoring.measure_scores,
            ),
            support=bench.support,
        )
        result = dict(case=dict(name=case), cache_granularity=dict(production=trace()))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            path = Path(folder) / "case.json"
            with patch.object(controls, "assert_choice"), patch.object(
                matched,
                "modules",
                side_effect=lambda left, right, selected: (left, right),
            ), patch.object(
                controls,
                "freeze",
                side_effect=[
                    dict(same_tile=True),
                    dict(same_tile=not change_resources),
                ],
            ), patch.object(
                controls, "validate_side", side_effect=validate
            ):
                call = lambda: controls.run(
                    types.SimpleNamespace(
                        query_control_cycles=4,
                        rounds=2,
                        kernel_warmup_ms=200,
                        kernel_rep_ms=100,
                    ),
                    result,
                    path,
                    bench=api,
                    torch=None,
                    helpers=None,
                    device=types.SimpleNamespace(synchronize=lambda: None),
                    native=None,
                    candidate=candidate,
                    production=production,
                    native_chunks=[],
                    production_chunks=banks["a"],
                    candidate_chunks=banks["b"],
                    production_args=owners["a"],
                    args=owners["b"],
                    monitor=lambda label: dict(label=label),
                )
                if fail_validation or change_resources:
                    with self.assertRaises((AssertionError, RuntimeError)):
                        call()
                    self.assertNotEqual(result["query_controls"]["status"], "passed")
                    if fail_validation:
                        self.assertEqual(len(validations), 25)
                        self.assertEqual(validations[-1], ("production", "b", "score"))
                        last = result["query_controls"]["measurements"][-1]
                        self.assertEqual(last["condition"], "shared_b")
                        self.assertFalse(last["measurement_validated"])
                    return
                call()
            diagnostic = result["query_controls"]
            self.assertEqual(diagnostic["status"], "passed")
            self.assertFalse(diagnostic["formal_acceptance_eligible"])
            jobs = controls.schedule(case, 4)
            self.assertEqual(len(diagnostic["measurements"]), len(jobs))
            self.assertEqual(len(validations), len(jobs) * 4)
            for entry, job in zip(diagnostic["measurements"], jobs):
                self.assertEqual(
                    entry["measurement_order"],
                    [["baseline", "candidate"], ["candidate", "baseline"]],
                )
                self.assertEqual(
                    (entry["baseline_bank"], entry["candidate_bank"]),
                    controls.CONDITIONS[job["condition"]],
                )
                self.assertTrue(entry["measurement_validated"])
            saved = json.loads(path.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(saved, result)
            rows = list(
                csv.DictReader(
                    io.StringIO(path.with_suffix(".controls.tsv").read_text()),
                    delimiter="\t",
                )
            )
            self.assertEqual(len(rows), len(jobs))

    def test_both_case_orchestrations_and_all_buffer_owners(self):
        for case in controls.CASES:
            with self.subTest(case=case):
                self.run_harness(case)

    def test_bad_first_shared_output_is_not_hidden(self):
        self.run_harness(controls.CASES[1], fail_validation=True)

    def test_recompilation_during_timing_is_rejected(self):
        self.run_harness(controls.CASES[0], change_resources=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

class JointTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_signature_gate_and_tuner_plumbing_change(self):
        old = split.function(split.KERNEL)
        new = split.function(KERNEL)
        self.assertEqual(new.args.args[-1].arg, "QUERY_PARTS")
        new.args.args.pop()
        old_gate = next(
            n
            for n in old.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and n.target.id == "SPLIT_QUERY"
        )
        new_gate = next(
            n
            for n in new.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and n.target.id == "SPLIT_QUERY"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            ast.dump(new_gate.value),
            ast.dump(
                ast.parse(
                    "IS_FP8 and TILE_R >= 32 and QUERY_PARTS == 2", mode="eval"
                ).body
            ),
        )
        new_gate.value = copy.deepcopy(old_gate.value)
        new.decorator_list = copy.deepcopy(old.decorator_list)
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(old), ast.dump(new))
        for parts in (1, 2):
            for fp8 in (True, False):
                for tile in (4, 8, 16, 32, 64):
                    condition = compile(
                        ast.parse(
                            "IS_FP8 and TILE_R >= 32 and QUERY_PARTS == 2", mode="eval"
                        ),
                        "gate",
                        "eval",
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(
                        eval(
                            condition, dict(IS_FP8=fp8, TILE_R=tile, QUERY_PARTS=parts)
                        ),
                        fp8 and tile >= 32 and parts == 2,
                    )

    def test_yaml_keeps_all_original_choices_and_prunes_bf16_duplicates(self):
        groups = yaml.safe_load(
            (
                ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_nvidia/tune_configs.yaml"
            ).read_text()
        )
        base = groups["qsa_select_paged_prefill_tuning_round1_score"]
        joint = groups[policy.CONFIG_GROUP]
        configs = [types.SimpleNamespace(kwargs=dict(c["META"])) for c in joint]
        self.assertEqual(len(joint), 17)
        full = [
            {**c, "META": {k: v for k, v in c["META"].items() if k != "QUERY_PARTS"}}
            for c in joint
            if c["META"]["QUERY_PARTS"] == 1
        ]
        halves = [
            {**c, "META": {k: v for k, v in c["META"].items() if k != "QUERY_PARTS"}}
            for c in joint
            if c["META"]["QUERY_PARTS"] == 2
        ]
        self.assertEqual(full, base)
        self.assertEqual(halves, [c for c in base if c["META"]["TILE_R"] >= 32])
        self.assertEqual(len(policy.prune_configs(configs, {"IS_FP8": True})), 17)
        pruned = policy.prune_configs(configs, {}, IS_FP8=False)
        self.assertEqual(len(pruned), 10)
        self.assertTrue(all(c.kwargs["QUERY_PARTS"] == 1 for c in pruned))
        for fp8 in (False, True):
            traces = [
                dict(route="rectangular", constants=c.kwargs)
                for c in policy.prune_configs(configs, {"IS_FP8": fp8})
            ]
            policy.validate_choices(traces, fp8)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "ineligible"):

    def test_control_config_label_ignores_only_query_mode(self):

    def test_factory_keeps_host_topk_and_independent_caches(self):
        test = page.PageTableTests()

    def test_fixed_modes_match_every_other_config_and_freeze(self):
        kernel = types.SimpleNamespace(
            asm={"ptx": "", "cubin": b""}, metadata=types.SimpleNamespace()
        )
        calls = []

        class Jit:
            def __getitem__(self, grid):
                def launch(*a, **kw):
                    calls.append(kw)
                    return kernel

                return launch

        entry = types.SimpleNamespace(
            arg_names=["num_rows", "query_offset", "logits_width"],
            fn=types.SimpleNamespace(fn=Jit()),
        )
        traces = [
            dict(
                rows=64,
                offset=0,
                width=1024,
                route="rectangular",
                constants=dict(TILE_R=64, QUERY_PARTS=1),

            dict(
                rows=3,
                offset=64,
                width=1024,
                route="rectangular",
                constants=dict(TILE_R=8, QUERY_PARTS=1),
            ),
        ]
        pair = []
        for parts in (1, 2):
            e = matched.FixedEntry(entry, traces, "rectangular", query_parts=parts)
            for t in traces:
                e[lambda c: (c["TILE_R"],)](t["rows"], t["offset"], t["width"])
            pair.append(
                types.SimpleNamespace(
                    _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=e,
                    _qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel=matched.FixedEntry(
                        entry, traces, "compact"
                    ),
                )
            )
        self.assertEqual([c["QUERY_PARTS"] for c in calls], [1, 1, 2, 1])
        records = matched.freeze_and_records(pair, query_parts=(1, 2))
        self.assertTrue(records["configs_match"])
        self.assertEqual(records["query_parts_pair"], [1, 2])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "requested"):
            matched.freeze_and_records(pair, query_parts=(1, 1))

    def test_joint_acceptance_requires_fixed_comparison_and_control(self):
        s = goals.AcceptanceTests.summary()
        s["manifest"]["options"].update(
            candidate="query-joint", compare_previous_tuning=False
        )
        for c in s["cases"]:
            c["runtime"] = dict(
                operator_binding=dict(canonical_sha256=trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256)
            )
            for k in ("score_vs_production", "pipeline_vs_production"):
                c["stages"][k] = copy.deepcopy(c["stages"]["pipeline"])
            if c["case"]["name"] == "observed_short_batch3_bfloat16":
                c["stages"]["pipeline_buffer_swap"] = copy.deepcopy(
                    c["stages"]["pipeline"]
                )
                c["stages"]["pipeline_buffer_swap"].update(
                    baseline_kind="production_swapped_buffers", includes_topk=True
                )
                c["bf16_control"] = dict(same_topk=True)
        fp = next(c for c in s["cases"] if c["case"]["dtype"] == "float8_e4m3fn")
        fp["cache_granularity"] = dict(
            production=[dict(route="rectangular", constants=dict(TILE_R=64))]
        )
        fp["query_joint"] = dict(
            matched=dict(configs_match=True, query_parts_pair=[1, 2])
        )
        fp["stages"]["score_matched"] = copy.deepcopy(fp["stages"]["score"])
        fp["stages"]["score_matched"].update(
            baseline_kind="joint_tile_full_query", includes_topk=False
        )
        self.assertTrue(trial.acceptance(s)["measurement_valid"])
        fp["query_joint"]["matched"]["query_parts_pair"] = [1, 1]
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(s)["measurement_valid"])
        fp["query_joint"]["matched"]["query_parts_pair"] = [1, 2]
        control = next(
            c
            for c in s["cases"]
            if c["case"]["name"] == "observed_short_batch3_bfloat16"
        )
        control["stages"].pop("pipeline_buffer_swap")
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(s)["measurement_valid"])

    def test_buffer_swap_replays_correct_owner_and_validation_outputs(self):
        calls = []

        def module(label, topk_name):
            obj = types.SimpleNamespace(_prefill_logits=lambda *a, **kw: (label, a[5]))
            setattr(
                obj,
                topk_name,
                lambda logits, *a, **kw: calls.append((label, logits, a[1])),
            )
            return obj

        native = module("native", "_topk")
        production = module("production", "persistent_topk")
        candidate = module("joint", "persistent_topk")

        def chunk(label):
            return dict(
                offset=0,
                rows=3,
                width=4,
                score_args=(None,) * 5 + (label,),
                score_kwargs={},
                topk_args=(None, None, label + "_out", None),
                topk_kwargs={},
                common_logits=None,
            )

        n, p, c = [chunk(x) for x in ("native", "production", "candidate")]
        functions = trial.swapped_pipeline_functions(
            native, production, candidate, [n], [p], [c]
        )
        functions["baseline"]()
        functions["candidate"]()
        self.assertEqual(
            calls,
            [
                ("production", ("production", "candidate"), "candidate_out"),
                ("joint", ("joint", "production"), "production_out"),
            ],
        )
        worker = next(
            n
            for n in ast.parse(Path(bench.__file__).read_text()).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "worker"
        )
        validate = next(
            n
            for n in worker.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "validate"
        )
        seen = []
        ns = dict(
            bench.__dict__,
            functions={"pipeline_buffer_swap": functions},
            args=("candidate_output",),
            production_args=("production_output",),
            native_chunks=[],
            torch=None,
            helpers=None,
            validate_pipeline=lambda *a: seen.append(a) or 1,
        )
        exec(
            compile(
                ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[validate], type_ignores=[])),
                "validate",
                "exec",
            ),
            ns,
        )
        ns["validate"]("pipeline_buffer_swap")
        self.assertEqual(seen[0][1:3], (("candidate_output",), ("production_output",)))

"""Composition proofs, real page-mask emulation, isolated host and report gates."""

import ast
import copy
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_accuracy_profiles as profiles
from tools import qsa_prefill_query_page_trial as trial
from tools import test_qsa_prefill_page_table as page
from tools import test_qsa_prefill_tuning_round1 as goals

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
KERNEL = ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_page_kernel.py"


def score(path):
    return page.score(ast.parse(path.read_text()))


def page_branch(fn):
    loop = next(n for n in fn.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
    return loop, next(n for n in loop.body if isinstance(n, ast.If))


class CombinedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_joint_change_is_exact_retained_bf16_page_branch(self):
        old = score(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_query_joint_kernel.py")
        new = score(KERNEL)
        loop, branch = page_branch(new)
        _, retained = page_branch(
            score(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_page_table_bf16_kernel.py")
        )
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(branch), ast.dump(retained))
        original_loop = next(n for n in old.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
        vector = next(
            n
            for n in original_loop.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
            and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)
            and n.targets[0].id == "physical_page"
        )
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(branch.orelse[0]), ast.dump(vector))
        loop.body[loop.body.index(branch)] = copy.deepcopy(vector)
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(old), ast.dump(new))

    def test_bf16_specialization_recovers_exact_page_candidate(self):
        original = score(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_page_table_bf16_kernel.py")
        new = score(KERNEL)
        self.assertEqual(new.args.args.pop().arg, "QUERY_PARTS")
        new.decorator_list = copy.deepcopy(original.decorator_list)

        class FullQuery(ast.NodeTransformer):
            def visit_AnnAssign(self, node):
                return None if node.target.id == "SPLIT_QUERY" else node

            def visit_If(self, node):
                if isinstance(node.test, ast.Name) and node.test.id == "SPLIT_QUERY":
                    return [self.visit(n) for n in node.orelse]
                return self.generic_visit(node)

        new = FullQuery().visit(new)
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(original), ast.dump(new))

    def test_actual_bf16_and_fp8_page_address_masks(self):
        for fp8 in (False, True):
            case = page.PageTableTests()
            case.kernel = KERNEL
            case.fp8 = fp8
            case.test_actual_load_branch_matches_vector_lookup_at_all_live_columns()

    def test_factory_reuses_host_bytecode_topk_and_has_independent_caches(self):
        case = page.PageTableTests()
        case.kernel = KERNEL
        adapter = types.SimpleNamespace(
            candidate_module=lambda p, **kw: trial.candidate_module(p)
        )
        with patch.object(page, "trial", adapter):
            case.test_factory_preserves_host_topk_and_isolates_aligned_entry_classes()
        kernel = ast.parse(KERNEL.read_text())
        self.assertTrue(
            any(
                isinstance(n, ast.keyword) and n.arg == "prune_configs_by"
                for n in ast.walk(kernel)
            )
        )

    @staticmethod
    def summary():
        summary = goals.AcceptanceTests.summary()
        summary["manifest"]["options"].update(
            candidate="query-joint-page", compare_previous_tuning=False
        )
        for c in summary["cases"]:
            c["runtime"] = dict(
                operator_binding=dict(canonical_sha256=trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256)
            )
            for key in ("score_vs_production", "pipeline_vs_production"):
                c["stages"][key] = copy.deepcopy(c["stages"]["pipeline"])
            c["production_score_configs"] = [dict(TILE_R=8, QUERY_PARTS=1)]
            c["query_page"] = dict(
                baseline_source_sha256=trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256,
                page_gate="not IS_FP8 and BLOCK_N<=PAGE_SIZE",
                configs=copy.deepcopy(c["production_score_configs"]),
                same_topk=True,
            )
            if c["case"]["name"] == "observed_short_batch3_bfloat16":
                c["stages"]["pipeline_buffer_swap"] = copy.deepcopy(
                    c["stages"]["pipeline"]
                )
                c["stages"]["pipeline_buffer_swap"].update(
                    baseline_kind="production_swapped_buffers", includes_topk=True
                )
                c["bf16_control"] = dict(same_topk=True)
        fp = next(c for c in summary["cases"] if c["case"]["dtype"] == "float8_e4m3fn")
        fp["cache_granularity"] = dict(
            production=[dict(route="rectangular", constants=dict(TILE_R=64))]
        )
        fp["query_joint"] = dict(
            matched=dict(configs_match=True, query_parts_pair=[1, 2])
        )
        fp["stages"]["score_matched"] = copy.deepcopy(fp["stages"]["score"])
        fp["stages"]["score_matched"].update(
            baseline_kind="joint_tile_full_query", includes_topk=False
        )
        return summary

    def test_acceptance_preserves_joint_and_production_contract(self):
        s = self.summary()
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(s)
        result = trial.acceptance(s)
        self.assertEqual(s, snapshot)
        self.assertTrue(result["measurement_valid"] and result["target_met"])
        self.assertTrue(result["experimental"])
        self.assertEqual(result["candidate"], "query-joint-page")
        self.assertFalse(result["formal_production_acceptance"])
        for key in ("page_gate", "same_topk", "configs", "baseline_source_sha256"):
            bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
            bad["cases"][0]["query_page"].pop(key)
            self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        for stage in (
            "score_vs_production",
            "pipeline_vs_production",
            "pipeline_buffer_swap",
        ):
            bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
            target = next(c for c in bad["cases"] if stage in c["stages"])
            target["stages"].pop(stage)
            self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        bad = copy.deepcopy(s)
        bad["manifest"]["options"]["candidate"] = "query-joint"
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(bad)["measurement_valid"])
        fp = next(c for c in s["cases"] if c["case"]["dtype"] == "float8_e4m3fn")
        fp["stages"].pop("score_matched")
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(s)["measurement_valid"])

    def test_full_candidate_coverage_rejects_missing_skipped_or_partial_families(self):
        prefix = profiles.QUERY_PAGE_FILE + "::"
        records = {
            prefix + name: dict(result="passed")
            for name in (*profiles.QUERY_SPLIT_CASES, *profiles.PAGE_TABLE_CASES)
        }
        for name, count in (
            ("test_combined_rectangular_every_config", 8),
            ("test_combined_compact_every_config", 6),
            ("test_combined_full_entry", 12),
        ):
            records.update(
                {prefix + name + f"[{i}]": dict(result="passed") for i in range(count)}
            )
        self.assertEqual(len(records), 40)
        self.assertIsNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(records))
        absolute = {str(ROOT / key): value for key, value in records.items()}
        self.assertIsNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(absolute))
        for key in records:
            bad = copy.deepcopy(records)
            bad.pop(key)
            self.assertIsNotNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(bad))
            bad = copy.deepcopy(records)
            bad[key]["result"] = "skipped"
            self.assertIsNotNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(bad))
        bad = dict(records, **{str(ROOT / next(iter(records))): dict(result="passed")})
        self.assertIsNotNone(trial.validate_full_coverage(bad))

    def test_combined_cli_routes_full_file_and_frozen30(self):
        options = types.SimpleNamespace(
            candidate="query-joint-page", accuracy_profile="full"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            profiles.pytest_targets(options, ROOT),
            [
                str(ROOT / profiles.QUERY_PAGE_FILE),
                str(ROOT / profiles.PRODUCTION_FILE),
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(profiles.expected_nodes("query-joint-page")), 54)
        script = (ROOT / "tools/run_qsa_prefill_query_page_h800.sh").read_text()
        self.assertIn("--accuracy-profile full", script)
        self.assertIn("--rounds 2", script)
        self.assertNotIn("--cases", script)
        self.assertNotIn("--query-control-cycles", script)
        runtime = next(
            n
            for n in ast.parse(Path(bench.__file__).read_text()).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "runtime"
        )
        self.assertIn("query_page.candidate_module(op)", ast.unparse(runtime))
        worker = next(
            n
            for n in ast.parse(Path(bench.__file__).read_text()).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "worker"
        )
        self.assertIn("combined_trial or", ast.unparse(worker))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
